blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A language-model decoder carries state between decoding steps, and in hardware a wrong state update can leave the current token correct and corrupt the output several tokens later, so a design can pass output tests and still be wrong. AIChipBench asks what LLM coding agents need to build such hardware correctly. Agents implement quantized Qwen3.5, Gemma 3, Gemma 4, and Llama 3.2 decoders in synthesizable register-transfer-level (RTL) code against an executable integer reference that specifies the outputs and the stored state at every decoding step. They debug against public tests under fixed budgets; their frozen designs are graded on held-out token sequences, resets, memory stalls, and synthesis, and a second track asks them to speed up a correct design at nearly fixed area. Across 9,136 attempts by four coding agents, the difficulty lies in stored state. Feedback that points to the first state mismatch raises acceptance over output-only feedback in all 12 agent--task cells of a matched study, by 25.0 to 46.9 percentage points, and halves the agent-hours per accepted design. Regraded on new sequences and conditions, 45 of 69 accepted designs fail within the 32 steps their tests required. More than a third of attempts to speed up a correct design end without one. An overall score ranks Sol 5.6 and Fable 5.1 above Astra 6 and Opus 5.5, and both halves of the instances give this order in all 200 random splits. Hardware agents therefore need debugging feedback that exposes stored state, and their benchmarks need final tests well beyond the development cases.
blocks.zh: 一个语言模型的解码器在解码步骤之间携带状态,在硬件中,错误的状态更新可以让当前符号正确并腐蚀后数个符号输出,因此一个设计可以通过输出测试,仍然是错误的. AIChip Bench 问 LLM 编码代理需要什么来正确构建这样的硬件. 代理在可合成的注册-传输级(RTL)代码中执行已定量的Qwen3.5,Gemma 3,Gemma 4和Llama 3.2解码器,对应一个可执行的整数引用,指定每个解码步骤的输出和被存储状态. 他们对照固定预算下的公开测试进行调试;他们的被冻结的设计被分级到被搁置的代号序列,重置,内存摊位,和合成上,第二道赛道要求他们在近固定区域加速正确的设计. 在4个编码剂的9,136次尝试中,困难在于存储状态. 指向第一个状态不匹配的反馈在匹配研究的所有12个代理任务细胞中,提高接受率,高于只输出的反馈,达到25.0至46.9个百分点,并将每个被接受的设计的代理小时减半. 根据新的序列和条件重新定级,69个被接受的设计中有45个在所需的32个步骤内失败. 超过三分之一的尝试试图在没有设计时加快正确的设计端. 总体分数在Astra 6和Opus 5.5以上排名Sol 5.6和Fable 5.1,在全部200个随机分出的情况下,两者的一半都给出了这个顺序. 因此,硬件代理需要调试能暴露存储状态的反馈,其基准需要远远超出开发案例的最终测试.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: LLM coding agents now edit hardware code and run the compilers, simulators, and synthesis tools that check it. We study them on one such task, building an accelerator for a language-model decoder. At each decoding step, a decoder reads one token, computes scores over its vocabulary (logits), and updates values that later steps reuse, such as the attention key–value cache and the recurrent states of hybrid layers. This persistent state makes errors easy to miss. Suppose a hardware cache saves a result before the next module has taken it. If that module is busy for a few clock cycles, the cache saves the same result again and now holds an entry that should not exist. The token produced at that step is still correct, and the error reaches the output only when a later step reads the cache. In a small decoder we constructed with this defect, the stored state is first wrong at transaction 2, the logits at transaction 5, and the selected token at transaction 6 (Appendix B.5 ). A test that compares output tokens over the first few steps passes this design.
blocks.zh: LLM编码代理现在编辑硬件代码并运行编译器,模拟器,以及检查它的合成工具. 我们研究了他们的一项任务,为语言模型解码器建造加速器。 在每个解码步骤上,一个解码器读取一个符号,计算其词汇(logits)的分数,并更新后期再利用的值,如注意键 - 值缓存和混合层的反复状态. 这种持续状态容易错失错误. 如果硬件缓存在下一个模块接收之前就保存了结果. 如果该模块忙于几个时钟周期,缓存会再次保存相同的结果,现在却持有一个不应该存在的条目. 该步骤产生的符号仍然正确,只有在后一步读取缓存时,错误才到达输出. 在用这个缺陷构建的小型解码器中,存储状态首先在交易2中出现错误,在交易5中出现日志,在交易6中出现选中的令牌(附录B.5 ). 一个比较输出符号的测试,在最初的几个步骤上通过这个设计.

blocks.en: We ask what an agent needs in order to get such state right, and how an evaluator can tell whether it did. Two requirements follow. An agent working within a fixed budget needs feedback that points to the faulty update, because an output mismatch several steps later says little about where the error began. The final verdict must also come from tests the agent never saw, because an agent can fit its design to the tests it debugs against. In our runs, 148 agent-built designs pass every public test and fail final acceptance, and when frozen submissions are regraded, 45 of 69 accepted designs fail a new sequence or condition within the 32 steps their tests required.
blocks.zh: 我们问一个代理人需要什么才能使这种状态正确,评估者如何判断它是否正确。 以下两项要求。 一个在固定预算范围内工作的代理人需要反馈,以指向错误的更新,因为一个输出不匹配的几个步骤后来对错误的开始点没有多少说明. 最终判决也必须来自代理商从未见过的测试,因为代理商可以将其设计与调试时的测试相匹配. 在我们的运行中,148个代理制造的设计通过了每次公开测试和失败的最终验收,当被冻结的提交书被重新分类时,69个被接受的设计中有45个在所需的32个步骤内没有达到新的序列或条件.

blocks.en: AIChipBench (Figure 1 ) is built around these requirements and has three components. The LLM coding agent is a language model run in a tool-using harness: it inspects files, writes and revises hardware code, runs lint, simulation, and synthesis, reads test feedback, and submits a design within caps on wall time, tool calls, and output tokens. The target , a quantized Qwen3.5, Gemma 3, Gemma 4, or Llama 3.2 decoder, defines what the hardware must compute. The integer oracle , an executable reference that fixes every arithmetic decision of the target, gives the exact outputs and the exact stored state expected at each transaction , the point at which the hardware accepts a transfer and commits its result. Agents write register-transfer-level (RTL) code, which describes what a circuit computes and stores on each clock cycle. Synthesis maps that code onto the resources of a chip, here a field-programmable gate array (FPGA), whose logic and wiring are configured after manufacture. A submitted design is frozen and accepted only if it matches the oracle on held-out sequences, resets, and memory stalls, synthesizes, and leaves protected files intact. A second track, on power, performance, and area (PPA), starts the agent from a correct design and asks it to raise throughput by at least 5% with at most 2% more area while every check still passes. In the chip-design flow, which runs from architecture through RTL, verification, synthesis, and placement and routing to fabrication, the agents work at the RTL stage; their designs are placed and routed afterwards for measurement (Section 5 ).
blocks.zh: AIChip Bench(图1)是根据这些要求建造的,有三个组成部分。 LLM编码代理是一个在工具使用控制伞中运行的语言模型:它检查文件,写和修改硬件代码,运行 lint,模拟,和合成,读取测试反馈,并在墙上时间的封盖内提交设计,工具调用,和输出符号. 目标,一个量化的Qwen3.5,Gemma 3,Gemma 4或Llama 3.2解码器,定义了硬件必须计算的内容. 整数 oracle 是一个可执行的参考,它可以固定目标的每一个算术决定,给出每个交易的准确输出和预期的准确存储状态,即硬件接受传输并承诺其结果的点. 代理员写寄存器-传输级(RTL)代码,该代码描述一个电路在每个时钟周期中计算和存储什么. 将编码到芯片资源的合成地图,这里是一个可编程的场门阵列(FPGA),其逻辑和线程在制造后配置. 提交的设计只有在与被搁置序列上的甲骨文相匹配,重置,以及内存摊位,合成,保存保护文件完好的情况下,才会被冻结和接受. 第二道,关于动力,性能,和面积(PPA),从正确的设计开始,要求它提高至少5%的吞吐量,最多增加2%的面积,而每次检查仍然通过. 在芯片设计流程中,从建筑通过RTL、核查、合成、放置和路由到制造,这些制剂在RTL阶段工作;其设计在之后放置和路由以供测量(第5节)。

blocks.en: We evaluate coding agents, which edit, test, and revise over many tool calls, because building a decoder is a multi-step engineering task. A decoder takes thousands of lines of RTL (6,843 to 31,884 in the seven reference designs of the correctness track), and one clean validation-and-synthesis pass on the 0.8B reference takes 162 minutes, so an attempt’s outcome depends on how the agent edits, tests, and spends its budget as well as on the underlying model. This regime differs from single-shot RTL generation, and its results describe a model and its harness together.
blocks.zh: 我们评价编码代理,这些代理在很多工具调用上进行编辑,测试和修改,因为建造解码器是多步骤的工程任务. 解码器需要数千行RTL(正确轨道的7个参考设计中有6,843到31,884条),一个干净的验证和合成通过0.8B参考需要162分钟,所以尝试的结果取决于代理如何编辑,测试,花费预算以及基础模型. 这一制度与单发RTL生成不同,其结果描述了一种模式及其共同利用。

blocks.en: Earlier benchmarks cover parts of this setting. CVDP grades tool-using agents that work in a repository against hidden test harnesses, ChipBench includes hierarchical designs and debugging with simulation waveforms, and Build-A-Chip-Bench follows agents from a workload specification to a routed layout (Section 5 ). AIChipBench adds two capabilities aimed at stateful accelerators: an oracle that specifies the committed state of a decoder at every transaction, and a matched study that varies what public feedback reveals (output mismatches only, a flag that state differs, or the first state word that differs) while submissions are frozen and graded independently. Repeated attempts under fixed budgets measure each agent’s reliability and cost, both when building a correct design and, on the PPA track, when optimizing one, with place-and-route and board measurements.
blocks.zh: 先前的基准涵盖这一设定的部分内容。 CVDP级工具使用剂在存储器中工作,以对抗隐藏的测试带,Chip Bench包括了等级设计和模拟波形调试,Build-A-Chip-Bench遵循剂从工作量规格到路由布局(第5节). AIChip Bench 增加了两种能力, 用于状态加速器: 一个预告器在每次交易中指定一个解码器的承诺状态, 以及一个匹配的研究, 在固定预算下反复尝试衡量每个代理人的可靠性和成本,无论是在建立正确设计时,还是在PPA轨道上,在优化设计时,都采用地点和路线及板面测量。

blocks.en: Four coding agents make 9,136 attempts, and three results stand out. First, what an agent is told about state largely determines whether it succeeds. Feedback that locates the first state mismatch raises acceptance over output-only feedback in all 12 agent–task cells of a matched study, by 25.0 to 46.9 points, and lowers the agent-hours per accepted design from 13.4 to 6.5. It also beats a flag that only reports a state mismatch in all 12 cells, by 9.4 to 37.5 points, so locating the mismatch helps beyond reporting that state differs (Section 4.2 ). Second, passing a test suite does not establish that a design is exact, and output checks in particular miss errors of state. When 144 frozen submissions are regraded, 17 of the 85 sequences that fail within the required 32 steps are wrong only in stored state, so an output check of that length passes them (Section 4.3 ). Third, correctness is fragile under optimization: more than a third of the attempts to speed up a correct design end without one (Section 4 ). An overall score that multiplies the two track scores ranks Sol 5.6 and Fable 5.1 above Astra 6 and Opus 5.5 (Figure 2 ), and in all 200 random splits of the instances into halves, both halves put the same two agents on top.
blocks.zh: 4个编码代理尝试9,136次,结果突出. 首先,代理人被告知的状态在很大程度上决定了它是否成功. 找到第一个状态不匹配的反馈使匹配研究的所有12个代理任务单元格的接受率高于只输出的反馈,达到25.0至46.9分,并将每个被接受的设计的代理小时从13.4降至6.5。 它也比一个只报告所有12个细胞的状态不匹配的旗帜高9.4至37.5分,因此定位不匹配有助于报告该状态的不同(第4.2节)。 第二,通过测试套件并不能确定一个设计是准确的,特别是输出检查误差状态错误. 当144份被冻结的划界案重新分类时,在规定的32个步骤内未能完成的85个序列中,有17个只在存储状态下是错误的,因此,对长度的输出检查会超过这些序列(第4.3节)。 第三,在优化下,正确性是脆弱的:三分之一以上的尝试是在没有正确设计端的情况下加快正确设计端(第4节)。 将两个赛道的分数乘以Sol 5.6和Fable 5.1的总分,高于Astra 6和Opus 5.5(图2),在全部200个随机分出的情况中,均将相同的两个代理放在上.

blocks.en: Each task asks an agent to implement a quantized language-model decoder, from embedding lookup to output projection, in synthesizable RTL (Figure 1 ). The agent works in a sandboxed copy of a starting workspace, with tools for lint, compilation, simulation, bounded property checks, and synthesis, under caps on wall time, tool calls, and output tokens. An attempt is one fresh agent process in a fresh workspace; it ends when the agent submits or reaches a cap.
blocks.zh: 每个任务都要求代理执行一个量化的语言模型解码器,从嵌入到输出投影,在合成的RTL(图1)中. 代理工作在一个开始工作空间的沙盒复制件中,有用于嵌入,编译,模拟,定界属性检查,和合成的工具,在墙上时间的盖子,工具调用,以及输出符号. 尝试是新工作空间中的一种新代理工艺;当代理提交或达到上限时结束.

blocks.en: Public tests in the workspace compare the agent’s RTL with the oracle, from single operators and layers up to the full decoder and multi-step decoding. By default, a failed test reports the first mismatching state word: its layer, token, tensor, and index, and the expected and received integers ( full-state feedback). Two weaker settings, used in Section 4.2 , report output mismatches only ( output-only ) or report that state mismatched without locating it ( coarse-state ).
blocks.zh: 工作空间中的公开测试将代理机的RTL与甲骨文进行比较,从单运算符和层到全解码器和多步解码. 默认情况下,一个失败的测试会报告第一个不匹配的状态单词:它的层,令牌,亮度,和索引,以及预期和收到的整数(全态反馈). 第4.2节中所使用的两个较弱的设置,只报告输出不匹配(只报告输出),或者报告状态不匹配而不定位(粗态).

blocks.en: When the agent submits, its RTL is hashed, frozen, and graded on an independent clean copy. A submission is accepted only if it passes every gate: Y = I integrity ⋅ I public ⋅ I heldout ⋅ I synth ⋅ I local . Y=I_{\rm integrity}\cdot I_{\rm public}\cdot I_{\rm heldout}\cdot I_{\rm synth}\cdot I_{\rm local}. (2) The gates are (i) an integrity check on protected files; (ii) the full public suite, rerun with state checks whatever feedback the agent saw; (iii) a held-out suite with new quantized weights and token sequences, nonzero cache positions, reset after a nonempty token sequence ( reset after activity ), bounded memory stalls, and parameter reload (Appendix B.1 ); (iv) synthesis; and (v) for all tasks except the two nano tasks, bounded safety checks on reduced instances of the controller ( local checks ). Held-out results never return to the agent. On the correctness track, an attempt that ends at a cap is not graded and counts as a failure. Section 4.3 regrades accepted designs under new conditions.

blocks.en: One task asks the agent to adapt a supplied accelerator scaffold to the official 24-layer Qwen3.5-0.8B text configuration ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) (Figure 3 ). The scaffold is a working parameterized accelerator, so the module structure is given, and the agent writes the RTL that fits it to the target. Every task has a reference design that passes all gates, so the task can be completed. The nano and Gemma 4 E4B references were written by hand and reviewed independently; for the 0.8B and Llama 3.2 3B references, an agent drafted components that an engineer reviewed, edited, and integrated; the 4B reference was derived from a gate-passing submission of a model outside the four evaluated agents, with 70 lines changed in its reset sequencing and parameter-loading wrapper (Appendix A.1 ). The 0.8B reference decodes 3.999 tokens per second at a 126 MHz clock, and its contract agrees with the 32-bit floating-point (FP32) model on 99.14% of top-1 next-token decisions.

blocks.en: 2.2 What AIChipBench stresses
blocks.zh: 2.2 AIChip Bench强调的内容

blocks.en: A decoder task combines five demands.
blocks.zh: 解码任务结合了五个要求.

blocks.en: Integer arithmetic to the bit. The contract fixes every rounding and saturation decision. Requantization, for example, rounds to the nearest integer with ties to even and then clips (Appendix B.4 ), and a design with the wrong rounding mode fails the public tests (Table 14 ).
blocks.zh: 整数算到位. 合同确定了每一轮圆和饱和的决定。 例如,将回合重排到最接近的整数,然后与偶数和然后的剪辑连结(Appendix B.4 ),而使用错误的圆形模式的设计则失败了公开测试(表14 ).

blocks.en: State committed only on accepted transfers. A decoding step takes many clock cycles, and modules exchange data through valid/ready handshakes: a transfer happens only in a cycle in which the sender’s data is valid and the receiver is ready, and otherwise the sender must hold its data (backpressure). A state word may change only when the transfer that produces it is accepted; a design that writes state whenever a result is valid can commit a value twice under backpressure (Appendix B.5 ). Because designs may pipeline or reorder work, correctness is checked at each transaction , one accepted transfer of an input and its result, and the cycle-level timing is left to the design.
blocks.zh: 国家只承诺接受转让。 解码步骤需要许多时钟循环,模块通过有效/准备的握手来交换数据:传输只发生在发送者数据有效且接收器准备好的周期,否则发送者必须持有其数据(后压). 一个状态词只有在生成它的传输被接受时才能改变;一个设计只要一个结果有效,就可以在后压下两次输入一个值(附录B.5. 由于设计可能进行管道化或重排工程,在每次交易时都会检查正确性,一次输入及其结果的接受转移,循环级别的时间留给设计.

blocks.en: State that stays exact across steps and conditions. Later steps read what earlier steps commit, so a state defect can surface late, as in the constructed decoder of Section 1 (Appendix B.5 ). There, a scripted repair that guards only the cache payload makes every output exact while the state and commit checks still fail. A design must also stay exact when reset after activity, at nonzero cache positions, and when memory responses stall. A test that starts from reset at position zero with an always-ready memory exercises none of these.
blocks.zh: 严守步骤和条件的国家。 后步骤读取了先前步骤所承诺的内容,因此状态缺陷可能出现较晚,如第1节(附录B.5 . 在那里,一个脚本修复,只有缓存有效载荷的守卫使每个输出都精确,而状态和承诺检查仍然失败. 在活动后重置时,在非零缓存位置,以及内存响应停顿时,设计也必须保持精确. 测试从零位置重置开始, 并且始终可以进行内存练习。

blocks.en: Hardware quality without loss of exactness. In the power, performance, and area (PPA) track (Section 2.4 ), a correct design is the starting point, and the agent must make it faster at nearly fixed area while every correctness check still passes.
blocks.zh: 硬件质量不失精确度. 在动力,性能,和区(PPA)轨迹(第2.4节)中,正确的设计是起点,代理必须在接近固定的区域内更快地完成,同时每一次正确度检查仍然通过.

blocks.en: Slow tools under a fixed budget. One clean pass of validation and synthesis on the 0.8B reference design takes 162 minutes, 31 of them for synthesis and timing (Appendix B.7 ), so a 12-hour attempt fits fewer than five such passes.
blocks.zh: 固定预算下缓慢的工具. 0.8B参考设计上一个干净的验证和合成通道需要162分钟,其中31分钟用于合成和计时(Appendix B.7 ),因此12小时的尝试适合这种通道不到5个.

blocks.en: 2.3 Correctness track: tasks and scoring
blocks.zh: 2.3 国家 正确性轨迹:任务和评分

blocks.en: The correctness track (Table 1 ) has twelve tasks on seven targets from three model families: Qwen3.5 ( Qwen Team, 2026a ; Qwen Team, 2026c ) , Gemma 3 and 4 ( Google DeepMind, 2025 ; Google DeepMind, 2026 ) , and Llama 3.2 ( Meta, 2024 ) . Tasks differ in the starting workspace. In construction from interfaces , the workspace supplies module declarations, testbench interfaces, arithmetic components, and supporting files, but no decoder implementation; in scaffold adaptation , it supplies a working accelerator to adapt. Tasks also differ in the decoding horizon, the number of decoding steps the tests require. Two tasks use Qwen3.5-nano, our name for a compact Qwen-derived configuration with four layers (three GDN, one full attention), width 256, and a 4,096-token vocabulary (Appendix C.1 ): T2 decodes one step and T3 eight recurrent steps. The labels follow an earlier task series in which T1 is a single decoder layer (Appendix G ). The other ten tasks require 32 steps. Across the twelve tasks, reference designs have 6,843 to 31,884 lines of RTL. A scaffold supplies 16,308 to 27,492 of them, and accepted adaptations add a median of 1,382 to 2,311 lines; from interfaces, the agent starts with 284 to 746 lines and accepted designs add a median of 6,154 to 34,300 (Appendix Table 9 ).
blocks.zh: 正确性轨迹(表1)有三个模范家族的7个目标有12项任务:Quen3.5(Quen Team,2026a;Quen Team,2026c),Gemma 3和4(Google DeepMind,2025;Google DeepMind,2026),Llama 3.2(Meta,2024). 初始工作空间的任务不同. 在从接口构建时,工作空间提供模块声明,测试台接口,算术组件,以及辅助文件,但无解码器执行;在脚手架改造中,它提供工作加速器以适应. 任务在解码视野,测试所需的解码步骤数量方面也有所不同. 两个任务使用Quen3.5-nano,我们的名称是一个紧凑的Quen衍生配置,有4层(3 GDN,1个全注意),宽度256,以及4,096个托肯词汇(附录C.1): T2解码为1步,T3为8次重复步. 标签沿用了较早的任务系列,其中T1是一个单一的解码层(Appendix G ). 其他10项任务需要32个步骤。 在12项任务中,参考设计有6,843至31,884条RTL线. 一台脚手架供给了其中16,308至27,492条,接受的改造增加了1,382至2,311条线路的中位数;从接口开始,代理开始为284至746条线路,接受的设计增加了6,154至34,300条的中位数(附录表9 ).

Cases: public / held-out test cases. Caps: wall time (h) / tool calls / output tokens per attempt, by starting workspace. Agreement: pooled top-1 agreement of the target’s integer contract with FP32.
blocks.zh: 表1:AIChip Bench正确性轨迹。 在7个解码器目标上执行12项任务;盖子列中的每个条目都是一项任务. 步骤:解码测试所需的步骤. 案例:公开/搁置测试案例。 Caps:墙壁时间 (h) / 工具调用 / 输出符号,每次尝试,通过开始工作空间. 协议:目标整数合同与FP32的集合顶级协议。

blocks.en: A target qualifies when its reference RTL passes every gate and its contract agrees with the FP32 model on at least 99% of pooled top-1 next-token decisions over common prefixes, a threshold set by this benchmark. The two conditions are distinct. Exactness is whether RTL reproduces the contract, and it is what agents are graded on. Fidelity is how closely the contract approximates the floating-point model; it is a property of the workload, and either can hold without the other (Section 3.3 ). Qwen3.5-nano falls below the fidelity threshold at 97.22%; we keep it because its tasks measure exactness and its small size keeps repeated attempts affordable. The Gemma 3 4B (text) and Llama 3.2-1B references qualify: each passes all 1,600 public and 240 held-out cases of its 32-step suite, and their contracts agree with FP32 on 99.00% and 99.31% of decisions; both also meet timing (Tables 4 and 70 ).
blocks.zh: 目标在参考RTL通过每个门时都符合条件,其合同同意FP32模式,即至少99%的集合式上下一级决定涉及共同前缀,这是该基准设定的门槛值。 这两个条件是不同的。 准确性是RTL是否复制合同,是哪些代理被分级. 忠贞度是指合同与浮动点模型的近似程度;它是工作量的一个属性,两者之一均可不持有(第3.3节)。 Quen3.5-nano低于97.22%的忠诚阈值;我们保持这一阈值,因为其任务精确度和小尺寸使反复尝试能够负担得起。 Gemma 3 4B(文本)和Llama 3.2-1B的参考书符合条件:每份都通过其32步套房的所有1 600个公开案件和240个搁置案件,他们的合同与FP32就99.00 %和99.31%的决定达成一致;两者都符合时间安排(表4和70)。

blocks.en: On this track we report an agent’s acceptance rate over all attempts, p ^ = ∑ i Y i / N \hat{p}=\sum_{i}Y_{i}/N , with a Wilson 95% interval. We also report agent-hours per accepted design: total agent time, failed attempts included, divided by the number accepted (Appendix A.3 ). Two diagnostic studies extend the track: a feedback study repeats three tasks under weaker feedback (Section 4.2 ), and a controlled matrix varies the horizon, an added state condition, and the budget from one nano scaffold (Section 4.4 ). Appendix G covers the earlier task series, run by two cohorts at different times.
blocks.zh: 在这个轨道上,我们报告一个代理人对所有尝试的接受率,p = ∑ iY i / N\hat{p}=\sum_{i}Y_{i}/N,间隔为 Wilson 95%. 我们还报告每个被接受的设计的代理工时:总代理工时,包括失败的尝试,除以被接受的数量(附录A.3 ). 两项诊断研究扩展了轨迹:反馈研究在弱反馈下重复三项任务(第4.2节),控制矩阵会改变地平线,附加状态条件,预算来自一个纳米脚手架(第4.4节). 附 录 G涵盖早期的任务系列,由两个组在不同时间运行.

blocks.en: The PPA track measures hardware quality on four targets: Qwen3.5-0.8B and 4B, Gemma 4 E4B, and Llama 3.2 3B. Every design targets an AMD Alveo U250 FPGA (xcu250-figd2104-2L-e) and is evaluated at a 126 MHz target clock, batch size one, an eight-token prompt, and a common memory-service model. Throughput is R = f / C R=f/C for clock frequency f f , where C C counts all elapsed cycles per decoded token, memory stalls included; area is the FPGA look-up-table (LUT) count L L ; power P P covers the FPGA and attached DRAM and excludes the host; and energy per token is P / R P/R . An agent starts from the correct reference design and is asked to improve its throughput, resources, or energy efficiency. Attempt i i counts as improved only if the design stays correct, gains at least 5% throughput, and grows its LUT count by at most 2%: S i = I i correct ⋅ I [ R i / R 0 − 1 ≥ 0.05 ] ⋅ I [ L i / L 0 − 1 ≤ 0.02 ] , S_{i}=I^{\rm correct}_{i}\cdot I\!\left[R_{i}/R_{0}-1\geq 0.05\right]\cdot I\!\left[L_{i}/L_{0}-1\leq 0.02\right], (3) where R 0 R_{0} and L 0 L_{0} are the evaluator’s values for the starting design: 3.999 tokens/s and 61.8k LUTs for 0.8B, 0.800 tokens/s and 69.0k LUTs for 4B, 0.940 tokens/s and 74.4k LUTs for Gemma 4 E4B, and 1.120 tokens/s and 66.6k LUTs for Llama 3.2 3B. Energy efficiency is reported but does not enter the criterion. Each agent makes 96 attempts per target. The 0.8B and 4B reference designs are also carried through the backend: we place and route them with three implementation seeds, check timing closure at 126 MHz, and measure power on an FPGA board (Section 3.2 ). Agent designs are scored on the evaluator’s throughput, LUT, and energy values; as a check, every correct agent design is also placed and routed with three seeds (Section 3.2 ).

blocks.en: The agent edits only the RTL; placement and routing run after it submits. Designs are implemented with Vivado 2024.1, AMD’s placement-and-routing flow for its devices ( AMD, 2026b ) , which maps a synthesized design onto the U250’s fixed look-up tables, block RAM, DSP slices, and programmable interconnect and produces a bitstream. OpenROAD ( Ajayi et al., 2019 ) automates a different setting, ASIC physical design: its flow takes RTL for a chosen process design kit through floorplanning, placement, clock-tree synthesis, and routing to a layout of standard cells and memory macros. Vivado is the implementation flow for the U250, on which a routed design can be run and its power measured on the board; every routed and board result here is an FPGA result. An ASIC version would need a process design kit, cell and memory libraries, and physical verification, and its results would not be comparable with these FPGA numbers (Appendix E.2 ).
blocks.zh: 代理只编辑 RTL; 提交后放置和路由运行 。 设计与Vivado 2024.1(AMD, 2026b), AMD设备的投放和路由流(AMD, 2026b)一同实施, 将一个合成设计映射到U250固定的仰望表, 块内存, DSP切片,以及可编程的互联, 并产生比特流. OpenROAD(Ajayi等人,2019年) 自动化了不同的设置,ASIC物理设计:其流量通过地板规划,放置,时钟树合成,以及通往标准单元格和内存宏的布局,为所选择的流程设计套件牵引RTL. Vivado是U250的实现流,在这个流上可以运行路由设计,并在板上测量其功率;这里每个路由和板的结果都是FPGA结果. ASIC版本需要一个流程设计工具包,单元格和内存库,以及物理校验,其结果与这些FPGA数字(附录E.2)无法比较.

The score is the product of the two track percentages, so it is high only when both are. All agents attempt the same task instances, so the score’s 95% interval is a paired bootstrap over instances (Appendix D.9 ).

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: We evaluate four coding agents, Sol 5.6, Astra 6, Opus 5.5, and Fable 5.1, all run through the MathCode harness ( Team Math-AI, 2026 ) . Each makes 472 attempts on the correctness track and 384 on the PPA track. The four agents receive the same task instances, starting files, instructions, tools, feedback, and caps; a task instance fixes the initial RTL files, quantized parameter arrays, public inputs, and held-out test assignment. The diagnostic studies bring the total to 9,136 attempts (Appendix Table 7 ).
blocks.zh: 我们评价四个编码代理, Sol 5.6, Astra 6, Opus 5.5, 和Fable 5.1, 都运行在 MathCode 控制带(Team Math-AI, 2026). 每一个都进行了472次在正确轨道上的尝试,384次在PPA轨道上的尝试. 四个代理接收相同的任务实例,启动文件,指令,工具,反馈,以及封顶;一个任务实例会固定初始的RTL文件,量化参数数组,公开输入,以及搁置的测试任务. 诊断研究使尝试总数达到9 136次(附录表7)。

blocks.en: Fable 5.1 and Sol 5.6 score 25.0 and 24.5, and Astra 6 and Opus 5.5 score 16.8 and 16.5 (Figure 2 ); the gap comes mostly from the PPA track. To test whether the order depends on which instances are drawn, we split the matched instances of every task into random halves: both halves rank Sol 5.6 and Fable 5.1 above Astra 6 and Opus 5.5 in all 200 splits, against 17% of splits when the agents’ outcomes are permuted within instances ( p = 0.001 p=0.001 ; Appendix Table 56 ). Each track and the controlled matrix also yield an order that recurs across halves, though the orders differ (Appendix D.8 ). Scoring the PPA factor at the clock each design achieves after place and route gives 23.7 for Sol 5.6, 22.8 for Fable 5.1, 14.9 for Astra 6, and 15.6 for Opus 5.5, and all four differences between an agent of the first pair and one of the second stay below 0.05 after a Holm adjustment (Figure 4 b, Appendix Table 65 ).
blocks.zh: 寓言5.1和索尔5.6的得分是25.0和24.5,Astra 6和Opus 5.5的得分是16.8和16.5(图2);差距主要来自PPA赛道. 为了测试顺序是否取决于绘制哪个实例,我们把每个任务的匹配实例分成随机的二分之一:在全部200个样本中,将Sol 5.6和Astra 6上方的5.1和Opus 5.5分为一半,当物剂的结果在实例中被渗透时则分为17%(p=0.001p=0.001;附录表56 ) 。 每个音轨和受控矩阵也产生一个在一半之间重复的指令,尽管订单不同(附录D.8 ) 。 将PPA因子在时钟上进行计分,每个设计在位置和路线之后都实现,Sol 5.6、Fable 5.1、Astra 6、14.9和Opus 5.5的23.7、Astra 6和15.6,以及Holm调整后第一对代理人和第二个停留在0.05以下的代理人之间的所有四个差异(图4b,附录表65)。

blocks.zh: 3.1 正确性轨道

blocks.en: Sol 5.6 has 61.2% of its attempts accepted, Opus 5.5 55.9%, Astra 6 49.8%, and Fable 5.1 48.3%, at 23.9 to 31.4 agent-hours per accepted design (Appendix Table 53 ). On matched instances, Sol 5.6 is ahead of Astra 6 and Fable 5.1, and Opus 5.5 is ahead of Fable 5.1 (Holm-adjusted p ≤ 0.024 p\leq 0.024 ; Appendix D.8 ). About 26% of attempts end at a cap without submitting. Between 55 and 70% of attempts pass each suite, but only 48 to 61% pass every gate.

blocks.en: Of 1,536 attempts, 965 keep the design correct and 569 also meet Equation 3 (Table 2 ). Fable 5.1 improves the design in 184 of 384 attempts and Sol 5.6 in 151, against 123 for Astra 6 and 111 for Opus 5.5, a ranking that differs from the correctness track’s (matched test, p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). Among improved designs, the median throughput gain per agent is 12.2 to 17.0%; counting every attempt, an improved design costs 24.9 to 43.0 agent-hours. Because the criterion caps LUT growth, these are gains at nearly fixed area; over all correct submissions, gains are smaller and LUT use rises slightly (Table 63 ). Throughput and LUT counts are also recorded for the accepted Qwen3.5-0.8B designs of an earlier Sol 5.6 and Astra 6 study on the correctness track, which run at 4.225 to 4.527 tokens/s with about 62k LUTs (Appendix G ).
blocks.zh: 在1,536次尝试中,965次使设计正确,569次也符合方程式3(表2 ). 寓言5.1改进了384次尝试中的184次和151次尝试中的Sol 5.6的设计,而Astra 6则改进了123次,Opus 5.5则改进了111次,这一排名与正确性轨道的排名不同(匹配测试,p < 0.001 p < 0.001)。 在经过改进的设计中,每剂的中间吞吐量收益为12.2至17.0%;计及每次尝试,改进的设计成本为24.9至43.0个剂时. 由于标准限制LUT的增长,这些是接近固定面积的增益;在所有正确的提交材料中,增益较小,LUT的使用略有增加(表63)。 对早先的Sol 5.6和Astra 6关于正确性轨迹的研究中接受的Quen3.5-0.8B设计也记录了通过量和LUT计数,它们以4.225至4.527个令牌/秒的速度运行,约62k LUT(附录G.).

blocks.en: We placed and routed every correct PPA design with three seeds, and 925 of the 965 complete all three routes. At the achieved clock, 528 attempts meet Equation 3 : 495 of the 569 nominal improvements hold, 74 are lost, and 33 are gained (Figure 4 a, Appendix Table 64 ). Fable 5.1 loses the most, 28, and keeps the most improved designs, 168, against 146 for Sol 5.6. On the twelve tasks of the correctness track, accepted designs stay close to their references: over the 1,016 synthesized designs the median LUT ratio per task is 0.97 to 1.10, and in a routed sample of 144 designs the median throughput per task is 0.77 to 1.02 times the reference’s (Figure 4 d, Appendix D.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们把每一个正确的PPA设计 配有3个种子,965的925个完成所有3条路线。 在达到的时钟上,528次尝试达到方程式3:569次名义改进中,495次,损失74次,获得33次(图4a,附录表64)。 寓言5.1损失最大,28,保持了最改进的设计,168,对索尔5.6的146. 在正确性轨道的12项任务中,接受的设计与其参考值接近:在1,016项综合设计中,每个任务的中位值LUT比为0.97比1.10,在144项设计的路由样本中,每个任务的中位值吞吐量为参考值的0.77比1.02倍(图4 d,附录D.3)。

blocks.en: Table 3 : The optimized reference schedules raise throughput by 11.4 to 12.0% and efficiency by 7.5 to 8.5%, after place and route and on the board. Post-route and board results for the paired Qwen3.5-0.8B and 4B schedules. Top: baseline; bold: optimized. Means over three implementation seeds.
blocks.zh: 表3:优化参考时间表使吞吐量增加11.4%至12.0%,效率增加7.5%至8.5%,在位置和路线之后,并在板上。 配对的Qwen3.5-0.8B和4B时刻表的后路段和棋盘结果. 顶部:基线;粗体:优化. 意味着三个以上的执行种子。

blocks.en: Each reference design has a baseline and an optimized schedule ; the optimized one changes buffering, overlap, and scheduling and keeps the arithmetic and memory-service model. It raises throughput by 12.0% and power by about 3.9%, an estimated efficiency gain of 7.8% (Table 57 ). After place and route with three seeds, every baseline and every optimized 4B implementation closes timing at 126 MHz; the optimized 0.8B design closes on one of three seeds, so its mean operating clock is 125.3 MHz. Post-route and board results give throughput gains of 11.4 to 12.0% and efficiency gains of 7.5 to 8.5% (Table 3 ). In the cycle model, compute takes 65% of the baseline cycles per token and memory waits 28% (Appendix E.3 ).Post-route results also cover the nano, Gemma 4 E4B, Llama 3.2 3B, Gemma 3 4B, and Llama 3.2-1B references, and on eight agent designs and three references board power is within − 0.6 -0.6 to + 3.5 % +3.5\% of the post-route activity estimate (Figure 4 c, Appendix E.2 ). Board power is read from the U250’s on-board rail sensors (Appendix E.2 ).
blocks.zh: 每一个参考设计都有一个基线和一个优化的时间表;优化后的一个改变缓冲、重叠和排期,并保持算术和内存服务模式。 它使吞吐量增加12.0%,电力增加约3.9%,估计效率增加7.8%(表57)。 在三个种子的位置和路线之后,每个基线和每个优化的4B执行都以126MHz结束计时;优化后的0.8B设计关闭在三个种子中的一个上,因此其平均操作时钟为125.3MHz. 程序后和董事会结果带来11.4%至12.0%的吞吐量收益和7.5%至8.5%的增效(表3)。 在周期模型中,计算每令牌需要65%的基准周期,内存等待28%(附录E.3. 路线后结果还包括纳米、Gemma 4 E4B、Llama 3.2 3B、Gemma 3 4B和Llama 3.2-1B的参考文献,关于8个代理设计和3个参考文献板功率,在路线后活动估计的− 0.6-0.6至+3.5%+3.5%之内(图4c,附录E.2)。 板功率从U250的机载铁路传感器(附录E.2)读取.

blocks.en: 3.3 Reference designs beyond the benchmark targets
blocks.zh: 3.3 超出基准目标的参考设计

blocks.en: Table 4 : RTL exactness and contract fidelity can each fail while the other holds. Six reference workloads under the two numerical criteria. Five references pass every RTL check; Qwen3.6-27B has integration failures, and Gemma 2’s contract misses the 99% fidelity threshold.
blocks.zh: 表 4: RTL精确度和合同忠诚度在另一人持有时均可能失败。 根据两个数字标准,有六个参考工作量。 Gemma 2的合同错过了99%的忠诚门槛。

blocks.en: To test whether the contract and evaluator carry to decoders outside the benchmark, we built reference designs for the attention-only Gemma 2 2B ( Google, 2024 ) and the 64-layer hybrid Qwen3.6-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) (Appendix F.1 ). Table 4 compares them on exactness and fidelity with four references that qualify: Qwen3.5-0.8B and 4B, and the correctness-track targets Gemma 3 4B and Llama 3.2-1B (Section 2.3 ). Both meet timing (Table 70 ), and each fails a different criterion. Gemma 2 2B’s RTL matches its contract on every case, but the contract agrees with FP32 on only 98.38% of decisions. Seven of eight alternative integer contracts reach the threshold, and higher precision costs hardware: LUTs rise from 58.4k to 84.1k and throughput falls from 1.48 to 0.90 tokens/s (Appendix F.2 ). Qwen3.6-27B’s contract meets the threshold, but its RTL fails eight public and ten held-out cases even though every operator and layer check passes, so the defects appear only when layers are integrated. Two later revisions reduce the failures to one or two cases; neither passes every check, so Qwen3.6-27B does not qualify.
blocks.zh: 为了测试合同和评价员是否携带到基准以外的解码器,我们为只关注的Gemma 2 2B(Google, 2024)和64层混合型Qune3.6-27B建立了参考设计. (Quen Team, 2026b ) (附录F.1 ). 表4对准确性和忠诚程度进行了比较,列出了4个符合条件的参考文献:Qune3.5-0.8B和4B,以及正确性轨道目标Gemma 3 4B和Llama 3.2-1B(第2.3节)。 两者都符合时间要求(表70),而且每个标准都不符合不同的标准。 Gemma 2 2B的RTL在每一个案例中都与其合同相符,但合同只就98.38%的决定与FP32达成一致. 8个备选整数合同中有7个达到阈值,精密成本更高的硬件:LUT从58.4k上升到84.1k,吞吐量从1.48个指数/s下降到0.90个(附录F.2.). Qune3.6-27B的合同达到了门槛,但其RTL却未能解决8个公开案件和10个搁置案件,尽管每个操作员和层检查都通过,因此缺陷只在层层整合时才会出现. 后来的两次修订将失败减少到一两件;两次检查都没有通过,因此Qune3.6-27B没有资格.

blocks.en: Five findings recur across the two tracks and the diagnostic studies (Figure 5 ).
blocks.zh: 五个结论在两个轨道上重复,诊断研究(图5)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Agents adapt a scaffold more reliably than they build a full-size decoder from interfaces
blocks.zh: 4.1 代理对脚手架的调整比他们从接口建造一个全尺寸的解码器更可靠

blocks.en: Table 5 : Acceptance by task: building Gemma 4 E4B and Llama 3.2 3B from interfaces is hardest. Accepted/attempts per agent and task; the last row pools the four agents.
blocks.zh: 表5:按任务划分的接受情况:从接口中构建Gemma 4 E4B和Llama 3.2 3B是最困难的. 接受/尝试每个代理和任务;最后一行集合四个代理。

blocks.en: Acceptance depends strongly on the starting workspace (Table 5 ). Pooled over agents, 47.7 to 78.9% of scaffold-adaptation attempts are accepted. So are 80.5% (T2) and 71.1% (T3) of attempts on the four-layer nano tasks, which start from interfaces. Building a full-size decoder from interfaces succeeds less often: on 26.0% of attempts for Gemma 4 E4B, 32.3% for Llama 3.2 3B, 32.0% for Gemma 3 4B, and 39.5% for Llama 3.2-1B, and no agent exceeds 10 of 24 on either of the first two. On these four targets every agent does better from the scaffold, 408 of 704 attempts against 239, and construction from interfaces costs 46 to 184 agent-hours per accepted design (Appendices D.1 and D.2 ). On Gemma 3 4B and Llama 3.2-1B, where each agent attempts 64 matched instances from each start, six of the eight paired differences between starts have intervals that exclude zero (Figure 5 d). Appendix C.4 lists the steps that turn a decoder into a task.
blocks.zh: 接受与否在很大程度上取决于起始工作空间(表5)。 集合在特工身上,47.7%到78.9%的脚手架适应尝试被接受. 从接口开始的四层纳米任务尝试的80.5%(T2)和71.1%(T3)也是如此. 从接口建造全尺寸的解码器成功率较低:在26.0%的尝试中,Gemma 4 E4B成功,32.3%的尝试中,Llama 3.2 3B成功,32.0%的尝试中,Gemma 3 4B成功,39.5%的尝试中,Llama 3.2-1B成功,前两款中任何一个都没有任何代理超过10 24. 在这四个目标上,每个特工都比脚手架做得更好,704次尝试中的408次,而239次尝试,从接口开始的建造成本为46至184个代理小时,每个接受的设计(附录D.1和D.2). 在Gemma 3 4B和Llama 3.2-1B上,每名特工从每开始尝试64个匹配实例,开始之间的8对差异中有6对间隔排除0(图5d). 附录C.4列出了将解码器变为任务的步骤.

blocks.en: Agents also differ on single tasks. Opus 5.5 adapts Qwen3.5-4B in 12 of 24 attempts against 20 or 21 for the others, and Astra 6 and Fable 5.1 build Gemma 3 4B from interfaces in 9 and 14 of 64 attempts against 28 and 31 for Opus 5.5 and Sol 5.6; matched tests confirm both differences (Holm-adjusted p = 0.015 p=0.015 and p < 0.001 p<0.001 ; Appendix D.8 ). Astra 6 builds Gemma 4 E4B from interfaces in 3 of 24. The ranking also changes between experiments: on the controlled matrix of Section 4.4 , Fable 5.1 has 445 of 864 attempts accepted and Sol 5.6, first on the correctness track, has 385 ( p = 0.001 p=0.001 ). Outcomes also vary between attempts on one instance. With three attempts on each of eight Gemma 4 E4B and eight Llama 3.2 3B adaptation instances, the three outcomes disagree in 26 of 64 agent–instance groups (Appendix D.1 ).
blocks.zh: 代理在单项任务上也有不同. Opus 5.5在24次尝试中12次调整Qwen3.5-4B,其他尝试为20次或21次;Astra 6和Fable 5.1从接口中建造Gemma 3 4B,在64次尝试中9次和14次调整Opus 5.5和Sol 5.6的28和31次;匹配测试证实了这两种差异(Holm调整后p = 0.015,p < 0.001;附录D.8)。 Astra 6从24个中的3个接口构建了Gemma 4 E4B. 排名在实验之间也有变化:在第4.4节的控制矩阵上,5.1有445项864次尝试被接受,Sol 5.6在正确性轨道上第一,有385项(p=0.001 p=0.001)。 一次尝试的结果也各不相同。 通过对8个Gemma 4 E4B和8个Llama 3.2 3B适应案例的3次尝试,64个代理人-代理组中的26个结果有分歧(附录D.1)。

blocks.en: 4.2 Agents do much better when told where state diverges
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 听说州里有分歧 探员们会做得更好

blocks.en: On nano T2, nano T3, and Qwen3.5-0.8B, each agent attempted 32 task instances under each feedback setting; the three attempts on one instance form a matched block . Full-state feedback raises acceptance over output-only feedback in all 12 agent–task cells, by 25.0 to 46.9 points, and every block-bootstrap interval excludes zero (Appendix Table 34 ). Pooled, 144, 208, and 295 of 384 attempts are accepted under output-only, coarse-state, and full-state feedback, with nearly equal total agent time, so the cost per accepted design falls from 13.4 [11.3, 16.2] to 6.5 [5.9, 7.3] agent-hours, a ratio of 0.49 [0.42, 0.56]. Output-only and full-state feedback differ both in whether state is visible and in whether the mismatch is located. Coarse-state feedback reports a state mismatch without locating it, and full-state feedback exceeds it in all 12 cells, by 9.4 to 37.5 points, with intervals that exclude zero in seven. Removing any one of the 96 matched blocks keeps the pooled ratio between 0.48 and 0.50, and in each of the 12 agent–task cells the interval of the full-state ratio lies below one (Figure 5 a, Appendix D.4 ). Accepted designs also arrive earlier: by half the wall cap, 82 of 384 full-state attempts had submitted a design that was later accepted, against 67 under coarse-state and 52 under output-only feedback (Appendix D.7 ).
blocks.zh: 在纳米T2、纳米T3和Qwen3.5-0.8B上,每个毒剂在每个反馈设定下尝试了32个任务实例;在1个实例上的3个尝试形成了一个匹配的块。 全态反馈提高所有12个代理–任务单元格对只输出反馈的接受度,比25.0到46.9分,每个块-bootstrap间隔排除0(附录表34). 集合式,384次尝试中的144次,208次,295次在只输出,粗态,全态反馈下被接受,总代理时间几乎相等,因此每个接受的设计成本从13.4 [11.3,16.2]降至6.5 [5.9,7.3] 代理时数,比例为0.49 [0.42,0.56]. 输出单态和全态反馈在状态是否可见和不匹配位置上都有所不同. 粗态反馈报告状态不匹配而不定位,全态反馈在所有12个细胞中均超过它9.4至37.5分,间隔7分中排除0. 消除96个匹配区块中的任何区块,集合比率保持在0.48至0.50之间,在12个代理任务区格中,每个区块的完整状态比率间隔位于1以下(图5 a,附录D.4)。 接受的设计也提前到来:通过一半的墙盖,384次全状态尝试中有82次提交了设计,后来被接受,而粗体状态下为67次,仅产出反馈下为52次(附录D.7)。

blocks.en: Comparing the two state settings separates finding a state defect from repairing it. Among attempts with a state defect, agents find it slightly more often under full-state feedback, in 151 of 166 after a median of 1.35 agent-hours, than when told only that state disagrees, in 142 of 169 after 1.50 hours. Repair differs more: agents repair the defect in 123 of the 166 under full-state feedback, after a median of 2.69 hours, and in 87 of the 169 under coarse-state feedback, after 3.22 hours (Table 37 ). On the constructed decoder of Section 2.2 , one Sol 5.6 repair under each setting shows what the agent is told. Full-state feedback reports a cache valid count of 4 at transaction 2, where the oracle expects 2; output-only feedback reports logits [ 12 , 12 , − 6 , − 5 ] [12,12,-6,-5] at transaction 5, where the oracle expects [ 13 , 12 , − 6 , − 6 ] [13,12,-6,-6] . Both runs make the same one-line change, committing the cache entry only when the output transfer is accepted, and pass the held-out suite (Appendix B.6 ).
blocks.zh: 比较两个状态设置,可以发现状态缺陷与修复. 在出现国家缺陷的尝试中,特工发现在全州反馈下,在166个中位数1.35小时之后的151个中位数中,比仅被告知州有分歧的169个中位数中,在1.50小时之后的142个中位数中,稍多发现. 修复的差异更大:在全状态反馈的166个国家中,有123个在中位数2.69小时之后修复缺陷;在粗态反馈的169个国家中,有87个在3.22小时之后修复缺陷(表37)。 在2.2节的已建解码器上,每个装置下有一个Sol 5.6的修理显示代理人被告知什么。 完整状态反馈报告交易2时的缓存有效计数为4,其中甲骨文期望2;仅输出反馈报告记录在交易5时 [12,12,6,−5] [12,12,-6,−5],其中甲骨文期望 [13,12,−6,−6] [13,12,-6,−6]. 两种运行都做出相同的单行更改,仅在输出传输被接受时才承诺缓存条目,并通过被搁置的套件(Appendix B.6 ).

blocks.en: The gain splits between reporting that state disagrees and locating where. Full-state feedback adds 151 pooled acceptances over output-only feedback; 64 arise between output-only and coarse-state feedback and 87 between coarse-state and full-state feedback. Both increments are positive in every cell. Full-state exceeds coarse-state feedback by 9.4 to 37.5 points, with intervals that exclude zero in seven of the 12 cells; for the gain of coarse-state over output-only feedback, the intervals exclude zero in only two cells (Table 35 ).
blocks.zh: 收益分成两种,一种是报告状态不同,另一种是报告位置不同。 全州反馈比只输出反馈增加了151个集合接受;64个出现在只输出和粗态反馈之间,87个出现在粗态和全州反馈之间. 每个细胞的增量都是正数。 全态超过粗态反馈9.4至37.5点,间隔在12个单元格中的7个单元格中排除0;为获得粗态大于输出单态反馈,间隔仅在两个单元格中排除0(表35).

blocks.en: 4.3 Passing a test suite does not establish exactness
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 通过测试套房不能确定准确性

blocks.en: On the correctness track, 148 designs that pass every public test fail final acceptance, 115 of them on the held-out suite: 25 for Sol, 39 for Opus, 33 for Fable, and 51 for Astra. For the 36 such designs on Gemma 4 E4B, Llama 3.2 3B, and Qwen3.5-4B, the grader’s primary diagnoses are 13 integration, 13 state/protocol, and 10 arithmetic (Appendix D.1 ). The gap between what the agent sees pass and what is accepted is wider under output-only feedback: of 384 output-only attempts, 219 submit a design that passes every check the agent can see, 199 also pass the full public suite, and 144 are accepted.
blocks.zh: 在正确性轨道上,148个设计通过每次公开测试失败最终接受,其中115个在被搁置的套房:25个为Sol,39个为Opus,33个为Fable,51个为Astra. 对于Gemma 4 E4B、Llama 3.2 3B和Quen3.5-4B上的36个此类设计,该年级的初级诊断是13个整合、13个状态/protocol和10个算术(附录D.1)。 在只输出反馈下,代理所看到的通过和被接受之间的差距更大:在384次只输出尝试中,219次提交设计,通过代理所看到的每一次检查,199次也通过完整的公共套房,144次被接受.

blocks.en: Accepted designs can also fail under conditions their tests did not cover. We regraded 144 frozen submissions on Qwen3.5-0.8B, Gemma 4 E4B, and Llama 3.2 3B, 69 of which had been accepted, together with the three reference designs. Each design decodes eight new token prefixes under each of four conditions (a new prefix alone, nonzero cache positions, reset after activity, and bounded memory stalls) for up to 256 steps, which gives 32 sequences per design. The references stay exact throughout. Of the 69 accepted submissions, 45 fail at least one sequence within the 32 steps their tests required, although 2,123 of their 2,208 sequences stay exact. The failures concentrate in the conditions that exercise state: of the 85 failing sequences, 29 fail under bounded memory stalls, 28 under reset after activity, 19 at nonzero cache positions, and only 9 on a new prefix alone. At 256 steps, stalls remain the hardest condition, with 60.6 to 69.9% of sequences exact per target against 75.6 to 86.1% on new prefixes alone (Table 44 ), and only 20 of the 69 are exact on all eight new prefixes alone, and 482 of the 624 failing sequences first diverge in persistent state, a median of four steps before the output does (Figure 5 b). Within the required 32 steps, 17 of the 85 failing sequences, and 5 of the 45 failing designs, are wrong in state only, so an output test of that length would pass them. Longer output tests find these defects later: extended to 35 steps, output checks detect 79 sequences and miss 10 that the 32-step state check finds, and at 48 steps they miss none (Figure 5 c, Appendix D.6 ).
blocks.zh: 接受的设计也可能在试验没有涵盖的条件下失败。 我们重新对Quen3.5-0.8B号、Gemma 4 E4B号和Llama 3.2 3B号的144份被冻结的划界案以及三项参考设计进行了评级,其中69份已被接受。 每个设计在四个条件(单是一个新的前缀,非零缓存位置,在活动后重置,以及捆绑的内存摊位)的每个条件下解码8个新符号前缀,最多可达到256个步骤,每个设计给出32个序列. 参考文献始终准确无误。 在69份被接受的呈文中,45份在它们所需的32个步骤中至少一个顺序未能通过,尽管其2,208个序列中有2,123个顺序保持准确。 失败集中在锻炼状态的条件:85个失败序列中,有29个在捆绑的内存摊位下失败,28个在活动后重置,19个在非零缓存位置,只有9个在新的前缀上. 在256个步骤中,摊位仍然是最困难的,每个指标的序列精确度为60.6%至69.9%,而仅在新前缀上为75.6%至86.1%(表44),所有8个新前缀上只有69个步骤中的20个,624个失败的序列中只有482个在持续状态下首次出现差异,在产出前为4个步骤的中位数(图5b)。 在规定的32个步骤内,85个故障序列中的17个和45个故障设计中的5个只在状态上是错误的,所以这个长度的输出测试会通过它们. 更长时间的输出测试后来发现了这些缺陷:扩展至35步,输出检查检测出79个序列和错失了32步状态检查发现的10个,在48步没有错失(图5c,附录D.6 ).

blocks.en: On implementations with known defects, the complete evaluator rejects all 12 development defects and 43 of 48 held-out defects (89.6%); the public tests alone reject 3 of the 12 and 3 of the 48. It accepts every repaired counterpart and correct control (Appendices B.2 and B.3 ).
blocks.zh: 就已知缺陷的执行而言,完整的评估人员拒绝所有12个发展缺陷和48个搁置缺陷中的43个(89.6%);仅公开测试就拒绝12个缺陷中的3个和48个缺陷中的3个。 它接受每一个修复的对应物并正确控制(附录B.2和B.3).

blocks.en: 4.4 Longer horizons lower acceptance, and the budget binds
blocks.zh: 4.4 更长时间的接受率较低,预算约束

blocks.en: Table 6 : Acceptance falls as the required decoding horizon grows, at both budgets. Final acceptance by horizon and budget multiplier in the controlled matrix, pooled over four agents and three added state conditions. Every attempt starts from the same Qwen3.5-nano scaffold.
blocks.zh: 表6:随着两个预算所需的解码范围扩大,接受率下降。 在控制矩阵中最终按视野和预算乘数接受,集合了4个代理人,并增加了3个状态条件。 每一次尝试都从同一个Quen3.5-nano脚手架开始.

blocks.en: The controlled matrix starts every attempt from one Qwen3.5-nano scaffold and varies the required decoding steps (1 to 16), an added state condition (none, reset after activity, or bounded memory stalls), and a multiplier on all three caps. At the 1 × \times budget, pooled acceptance falls from 252 to 115 of 288 attempts between one and 16 required steps, and with no added condition every agent has fewer attempts accepted at 16 steps than at one (Table 6 ). A 1.5 × \times budget lifts the 16-step result to 169 of 288, but acceptance still falls at each longer horizon. On the Gemma 3 4B and Llama 3.2-1B tasks, the same instances at eight and at 32 required steps have 558 and 475 of 1,024 attempts accepted (Appendix D.2 ). How an added state condition changes the horizon effect depends on the budget. At 0.5 × \times , where at most 1 of 96 attempts per cell is accepted at 16 steps, the interaction is positive because acceptance has little room to fall; at 1 × \times it is negative for reset after activity, and the other intervals include zero (Appendix D.5 ).
blocks.zh: 受控矩阵从一个Quen3.5-nano脚手架开始每次尝试,并不同所需的解码步骤(1至16),附加状态条件(无,活动后重置,或有边框的内存摊位),以及所有三个盖的乘数. 在1xxx时间的预算中,集合接受从288次尝试中的252次下降到115次,在1至16个必要步骤之间,没有附加条件,每个代理人在16次尝试中得到接受的次数少于1次(表6)。 1.5×x\时的预算将16步的结果提升至288中的169步,但接受率仍然落在每一个更长的视野上. 在Gemma 3 4B和Llama 3.2-1B任务方面,在8个和32个必要步骤中,接受的尝试有558次和475次(附录D.2)。 附加状态条件如何改变地平线效应取决于预算. 在0.5×\时,每个单元格96次尝试中最多有1次在16步被接受,由于接受的空间很小,所以相互作用是积极的;在1×\时,在活动后重置是负的,其他间隔包括0(附录D.5).

blocks.en: The budget binds on the correctness track as well: 489 of 1,888 attempts end at a cap without submitting (322 on wall time, 105 on tool calls, and 62 on output tokens). Under full-state feedback, caps account for about half of the failures that remain: on the three feedback tasks, 43 of the 89 failed full-state attempts end at a cap, and 39 of these 43 had no state defect or had already repaired it. Caps also end 260 of the 465 failed attempts to build a full-size decoder from interfaces.
blocks.zh: 预算在正确性轨道上也有约束:1 888项尝试中有489项没有提交(墙上时间322项,工具呼叫105项,产出符号62项)。 在全州反馈下,封顶占了剩余故障的大约一半:在三项反馈任务上,89项失败的全州尝试中有43项以封顶结束,这43项尝试中有39项没有州缺陷或已经修复. 在465次失败的尝试中,Caps也结束了260次从界面中构建全尺寸解码器的尝试.

blocks.en: 4.5 Optimization often ends without a correct design
blocks.zh: 4.5 优化往往没有正确的设计

blocks.en: In the PPA track, 571 of 1,536 attempts end without a correct design, 90 to 185 of 384 per agent: 194 submit an incorrect design, and 377 reach a cap with RTL that fails the correctness checks. Every one of these attempts started from a design that passed every gate. In one such attempt (Figure 6 b), Sol 5.6 starts from the correct 0.8B design at 3.999 tokens/s and stops at the tool-call cap with a design that fails the correctness checks and runs at 3.803 tokens/s.
blocks.zh: 在PPA轨迹中,1,536次尝试中,有571次尝试没有正确设计而结束,每名代理中90至185次:194次提交不正确的设计,377次尝试与RTL达到上限而未能进行正确性检查. 每一个尝试都是从一个穿过每个大门的设计开始的. 在一次这样的尝试(图6b)中,Sol 5.6从正确的0.8B设计开始,为3.999令牌/秒,在工具调用盖上停留,设计失败正确性检查,以3.803令牌/秒运行.

(a) A full-state attempt finds and repairs its state defect and then reaches the 6-hour wall cap. (b) An optimization attempt starts from the correct reference design and reaches the 420-call tool cap with RTL that fails the correctness checks. (c) An output-only submission passes every check the agent can see and, after the RTL is frozen, fails the full public suite and the held-out suite (Listing 2 ).
blocks.zh: 图6:三次尝试记录摘录,自尝试开始后数小时及工具呼叫. (a) 完全状态尝试发现并修复其状态缺陷,然后达到6小时的墙顶。 (b) 优化尝试从正确的参考设计开始,达到420调用工具上限,但该上限没有正确性检查。 (c) 仅限输出的提交文件通过代理商所能看到的每一份检查,在RTL被冻结后,整个公共套房和被搁置套房(名单2)失效。

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: A digital design passes through several stages: a specification and an architecture; RTL implementation; functional verification; synthesis onto hardware resources; physical implementation, which places and routes the design and analyzes its timing and power; and finally deployment on an FPGA or fabrication as an application-specific integrated circuit (ASIC). Language models have been applied at several of these stages, including RTL generation, verification, EDA scripting, tool orchestration ( Liu et al., 2023a ; Wu et al., 2024 ) , and the full path from a workload specification to a routed layout ( Gunukula et al., 2026 ) . Given a target decoder and a fixed module structure, AIChipBench’s agents write, debug, and optimize RTL; the evaluator runs verification and synthesis, and placement and routing follow submission (Section 2.4 ). Architecture design and high-level synthesis lie upstream.
blocks.zh: 数字设计经过几个阶段:规格和架构;RTL执行;功能核查;合成到硬件资源;实际执行,将设计放在位置和路线上,分析其时机和功率;最后在FPGA上部署,或作为应用程序专用集成电路(ASIC)制造. 语言模型已在其中几个阶段得到应用,包括RTL生成、校验、EDA脚本、工具编织(Liu等人,2023a); Wu et al., 2024),以及从工作量规格到路由布局的全部路径(Gunukula et al., 2026). 鉴于目标解码器和固定的模块结构,AIChip Bench的代理撰写、调试和优化RTL;评价员进行核查和合成,并随提交而进行放置和路由(第2.4节)。 建筑设计和高级综合位于上游.

blocks.en: VerilogEval ( Liu et al., 2023b ) , built from HDLBits ( Wong, 2024 ) problems, RTLLM ( Lu et al., 2024 ) with its 2.0 release ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , TuRTLe ( Garcia-Gasulla et al., 2025 ) , and RTL-Repo ( Allam and Shalan, 2024 ) ask a model to generate or complete a module or design and simulate it against references; RTLLM and TuRTLe also score synthesis or PPA. ChipBench ( Yu et al., 2026 ) adds hierarchical and CPU-component generation, debugging, and reference-model generation. CVDP ( Pinckney et al., 2025 ) covers design, verification, debugging, and comprehension, and in its agentic tasks an agent works with tools in a repository before hidden harnesses grade the result; LBC-bench ( LBC-bench Team, 2025 ) reports model and agent results on CVDP tasks. Build-A-Chip-Bench ( Gunukula et al., 2026 ) , described in a blog post, carries agents through architecture and physical design to an ASIC layout scored on PPA. Appendix Table 75 compares what each benchmark grades. AIChipBench shares executable tools and hidden grading with the agentic benchmarks. Within a fixed module structure, it measures state-exact correctness of decoder accelerators over decoding steps, the effect of what debugging feedback reveals, and each agent’s reliability and cost over repeated budgeted attempts. Benchmark sizes count problems, designs, examples, or tasks, units comparable neither across benchmarks nor with agent attempts (Appendix H ). The closest feedback study is ChipBench’s, which gives models a buggy design with or without simulation waveforms (signals and internal state over time); the waveforms improve results for 8 models and lower them for 13. It differs from ours in information and protocol, so the results are not directly comparable. Architect Labs ( Architect Labs, 2026 ) studies RTL generation with verifiable rewards.
blocks.zh: VerilogEval(Liu等人,2023年b),由HDLBits(Wong,2024年)问题制造,RTLM(Lu等人,2024年),其2.0发布(Liu等人,2024年),TURTLE(Garcia-Gasulla等人,2025年),RTL-Repo(Allam和Shalan,2024年)要求一个模型生成或完成一个模块或设计,并参照参考进行模拟;RTLM和TURTLE也得分合成或PPA. Chip Bench(Yu等人,2026年)增加了等级和CPU组件生成,调试,以及参考模型生成. CVDP(Pinckney等人,2025年)涵盖设计、核查、调试和理解,在其代理任务中,一个代理人在隐藏的利用结果分级之前在存储库中使用工具工作;LBC-bench(LBC-bench Team,2025年)报告CVDP任务的模型和代理结果。 Build-A-Chip-Bench(Gunukula等人,2026年)在博客文章中描述, 附录表75比较了每个基准等级。 AIChip Bench与代理基准共享可执行工具和隐藏分级. 在固定模块结构中,它衡量解码器加速器相对于解码步骤的状态正确性、调试反馈所揭示的影响、以及每个代理商在预算反复尝试时的可靠性和成本。 基准大小计算出问题、设计、实例或任务,单位既非跨基准,也非代理尝试(附录H)。 最接近的反馈研究是Chip Bench's的,它给模型一个带有或没有模拟波形的buggy设计(随时间推移的信号和内部状态);波形改进了8个模型的结果,并降低了13个模型的结果. 它与我们的信息和规程不同,因此结果无法直接比较。 建筑师实验室(Architective Labs,2026)以可核查的奖励研究RTL生成.

blocks.en: EDASYTH ( Yuen and Hoang, 2026 ) gates transitions among symbolic calculations, simulation, and circuit artifacts, EEBench ( atopile, 2026 ) evaluates electrical engineering designs through simulation and cost, and the large-circuit-model perspective ( Chen et al., 2024 ) studies learning across specifications, RTL, netlists, and layouts. AIChipBench checks one transition, from a quantized model to RTL, against an executable state-transition contract.
blocks.zh: EDASYTH(Yuen and Hoang, 2026) 门在符号计算,模拟,和电路文物之间的过渡,EEBench(atopile, 2026)通过模拟和成本评价电气工程设计,以及大电路模型视角(Chen等人, 2024)研究跨越规格,RTL,网单,和布局学习. AIChip Bench对照可执行的国家-过渡合同,检查从量化模型到RTL的过渡。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: AIChipBench tests whether LLM coding agents can build decoder hardware that stays exact, in outputs and committed state, over many decoding steps, and whether they can make a correct design faster without breaking it. Its results locate the difficulty in stored state. When accepted designs fail under conditions their tests did not exercise, most of the failing sequences diverge in state before the output does, and output checks of the required length miss defects that a state check exposes. Agents, in turn, succeed far more often when they can see that state: feedback that locates the first state mismatch doubles pooled acceptance over output-only feedback, after which caps account for about half of the remaining failures. Correctness is also fragile under optimization, since more than a third of attempts to speed up a correct design end without one. An overall score ranks Sol 5.6 and Fable 5.1 above Astra 6 and Opus 5.5, and the order holds across random halves of the instances. Debugging tools for hardware agents should therefore report stored state, and final evaluations should test well beyond the development cases.
blocks.zh: AIChip Bench测试LLM编码代理是否能够在很多解码步骤上建立保持精确,输出和承诺状态的解码硬件,以及它们是否能够在不中断的情况下更快地做出正确的设计. 其结果定位到存储状态中的难度. 当被接受的设计在条件下失败时,他们的测试没有进行,大多数失败序列在输出之前在状态上存在差异,对所需长度的输出检查错过了状态检查暴露的缺陷. 代理商在看到这种状态时会更经常地取得成功:找到第一个状态不匹配的反馈将集合接受率加倍于只输出的反馈,之后的上限占剩余失败的大约一半. 在优化下,正确性也十分脆弱,因为超过三分之一的尝试试图在没有正确设计端的情况下加快正确设计端. 总体分数在Astra 6和Opus 5.5以上排名Sol 5.6和Fable 5.1,顺序为随机的减半。 因此,硬件代理的调试工具应报告存储状态,最终评价应远远超出开发案例。

blocks.en: Tasks fix the module structure, and agents do not place and route their designs. Graded horizons stop at 32 steps and regrading at 256. Whether feedback on stored state and held-out state conditions helps on other stateful hardware remains to be tested.
blocks.zh: 任务会固定模块结构,代理不会放置和引导其设计. 等级平面止于32级,复级为256级. 关于存储状态和持有状态条件的反馈是否有助于其他状态硬件,仍有待测试.

blocks.en: The arithmetic digest in Table 8 identifies one version of a numerical contract. A change in precision, a new nonlinear table, or a different accumulation order requires a new arithmetic version, even if next-token agreement improves. The baseline and optimized schedules of a reference design (Section 3.2 ) share one version: they use the same integer functions, parameter arrays, sequence lengths, and external-memory behavior, and both convert cycles to throughput at 126 MHz. Their RTL may differ in buffering, overlap, and scheduling; approximations and matrix dimensions stay fixed.
blocks.zh: 表8中的算术摘要确定了数字合同的一个版本。 精度的改变,新的非线性表,或者不同的累积顺序,都需要一个新的算术版本,即使下一个托肯协议有所改进. 参考设计的基线和优化时间表(第3.2节)共享一个版本:它们使用相同的整数函数,参数阵列,序列长度,以及外部-记忆行为,两者都以126MHz的速度将周期转换为吞吐量. 它们的RTL在缓冲、重叠和排程方面可能有所不同;近似和矩阵尺寸保持不变。

blocks.en: A.1 Task configuration and execution records
blocks.zh: A.1 联合国 任务配置和执行记录

blocks.en:
The starting workspace sets how much the agent must implement, so it is part of the task definition.
For construction from interfaces, it holds the supplied module declarations, testbench interfaces, arithmetic components, and any working RTL; for scaffold adaptation, it also holds the initial accelerator tree and the configuration that tree supports.
Agents can query the reference implementation of the numerical contract through the permitted oracle API but cannot read its source.
So that a starting workspace can be reproduced, the protocol requires an inventory, taken before the attempt, of every path the agent can read or edit, including any reference implementation it can access. Separate digests identify the public tests, oracle code, arithmetic tables, held-out evaluator assets, and hardware constraints.
Within a task, all agents start from the same implementation.
A change to the supplied implementation defines a different starting workspace, even when the instruction text is unchanged.
Figure 3 summarizes the Qwen3.5-0.8B adaptation task and its reference design in this form.
blocks.zh:
起始工作空间设定代理必须执行多少,因此是任务定义的一部分.
对于从接口构造,它持有所提供的模块声明,测试台界面,算术组件,以及任何工作中的RTL;对于脚手架改造,它还持有初始加速树和树支持的配置.
代理人可以通过允许的甲骨文API查询数字合同的参考执行情况,但不能读取其来源.
为了可以复制一个起始工作空间,协议需要一份清单,在尝试之前,对代理能够读取或编辑的每一条路径进行清点,包括它能够访问的任何引用执行. 单独的文摘可以识别公共测试,甲骨文代码,算术表,被搁置的评估资产,以及硬件约束.
在一项任务中,所有行动者都从同一执行开始。

blocks.en: The held-out suite’s new quantized weights are arrays generated within the supported shapes and ranges; they can catch hard-coded vectors and stale weight buffers. blocks.en: The pooled fidelity of the Qwen3.5-0.8B and 4B contracts rests on 1,000 sequences at each of eight decoding positions: 7,931 of 8,000 top-1 decisions match FP32 for Qwen3.5-0.8B (99.1375%) and 7,937 for Qwen3.5-4B (99.2125%). blocks.en: The local checks of Equation 2 are bounded safety checks on reduced instances of the controller. They assume a single clock, reset at the initial step, in-order memory responses, and response stalls of at most three cycles, and they run for 32 cycles. Five properties are checked: the output payload is stable while blocked, one accepted request commits at most once, reset clears valid state, issued addresses are in the configured range, and reload occurs only while idle.

blocks.en: The public tests reject three of the twelve: incorrect rounding, signed-accumulator truncation, and late convolution-state writeback. Protected-file hashing and test isolation address different risks, and the evaluator needs both: hashing detects edits to protected files, and isolation keeps held-out assets out of the agent’s workspace. blocks.en: This subsection describes two components the main text refers to (Section 2.2 ): the requantizer (Listing 1 ) and a buffer that commits state only on accepted transfers. blocks.en: This section shows a delayed state failure in a decoder with a cache, handshakes, and a memory interface, small enough to inspect in full. The authors constructed it for this case study: one attention head over a four-token vocabulary, embedding width 2, an eight-entry key–value cache of 16-bit words, 32-bit accumulators, one memory response per token, and valid/ready handshakes on input, memory, and output. A state word is the cache’s valid count or one cache entry. The reference RTL is one module of 143 lines, 134 of which are neither blank nor comment-only, and the testbench has 110 lines (Table 18 ). An integer oracle computes the expected logits and state. All results in this section come from Icarus Verilog simulation of each snapshot on a fixed, directed public suite of four cases (24 transactions) and a held-out suite of five cases (31 transactions).

blocks.en: The seeded defect writes the cache entry and increments the valid count whenever the output is valid, before the output transfer is accepted. Under output backpressure the design therefore commits one token more than once. In the public case with output stalls, the valid count is first wrong at transaction 2, the logits at transaction 5, and the selected token at transaction 6 (Figure 9 ). Two scripted repairs follow (Table 17 ). The first guards the cache payload with the output handshake but still increments the valid count; every logit and token of the public suite is then exact, while the state and commit checks still fail, and the held-out suite still fails four of five cases. The second commits the entry and the count only on an accepted output transfer and passes both suites; it reproduces the reference RTL byte for byte. The authors wrote both repairs as patches and replayed them in order, so the sequence shows what each check reports on a known defect. Appendix B.6 gives an agent run on the same defect, and the regrading of 144 frozen agent submissions and the three references (Section 4.3 ) is the corresponding evidence from real submissions.

blocks.en: To show what an agent does with each kind of feedback, Sol 5.6 repaired the seeded decoder once under full-state and once under output-only feedback (Table 19 ). Both runs start from the same RTL and see the same public suite, which fails one of four cases. Full-state feedback names the first mismatching state word: at transaction 2 the cache’s valid count is 4 where the oracle expects 2. Output-only feedback reports the first output mismatch, the logits of transaction 5. In both runs the agent’s first and only edit changes the commit condition from output valid to output valid and ready, a one-line change; the public suite then passes, the agent submits, and the frozen RTL passes all five held-out cases. On this small defect both settings lead to the same repair, and full-state feedback points to the premature commit three transactions earlier. One run per setting shows the mechanism; the feedback study of Appendix D.4 measures the rates. The runs use temperature 0.2, top-p 0.95, reasoning disabled, a 131,072-token context that keeps every public message without compaction, and caps of 24 tool calls, 0.5 hours, and 25,600 output tokens.

blocks.en: A decoder becomes an agent task after four steps, which the Gemma 3 4B and Llama 3.2-1B tasks of Appendix D.2 also followed. First, an integer contract for the decoder configuration fixes the quantized parameters, every rounding and saturation decision, and the state words the oracle checks after each step (Equation 1 ). Second, the contract must agree with the FP32 model on at least 99% of top-1 next-token decisions; Gemma 2 2B misses this threshold (98.38%) and is not an agent task, and Gemma 4 E4B misses it under its QF contract (98.49%), so its tasks use the Main contract. Qwen3.5-nano is the one exception: its contract reaches 97.22%, and it is kept because its tasks measure RTL exactness and its small size allows repeated attempts (Section 2.3 ). Third, a reference design must pass every gate of Equation 2 : the public suite, the held-out suite with new weights, prefixes, cache positions, reset after activity, memory stalls, and parameter reload, synthesis, integrity, and the local checks. Qwen3.6-27B’s reference fails eight public and ten held-out cases and is not an agent task. Fourth, the task fixes the starting workspace (interfaces or a scaffold), the required horizon, and the caps, and the agents attempt matched instances. Gemma 3 4B and Llama 3.2-1B passed the first three steps and became four tasks of the correctness track (Section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 解码器在经过四个步骤后成为代理任务,Gemma 3 4B和Llama 3.2-1B任务也遵循了附录D.2. 首先,一个解码器配置的整数合同会固定整数参数,每次四舍五入和饱和决定,并且状态词在每一步(方程式1 )之后写着甲骨文检查. 其次,合同必须同意FP32模式至少99%的顶级-1次接力决定;Gemma 2 2B错过了这个阈值(98.38%),不属于代理任务,Gemma 4 E4B错过了QF合同(98.49%),因此任务使用主合同. Quen3.5-nano是一个例外:其合同达到97.22%,之所以保留该合同,是因为其任务衡量RTL准确性,而且其小尺寸允许重复尝试(第2.3节)。 第三,参考设计必须经过方程式2的每个门:公共套房,有新重量的被搁置套房,前缀,缓存位置,活动后重置,内存摊位,以及参数重装,合成,完整性,以及本地检查. Qwen3. 6-27B的引用失败了8起公开案件和10起搁置案件,不是代理任务. 第四,任务修补起始工作空间(界面或脚手架),所需视野,以及盖子,代理尝试匹配实例. Gemma 3 4B和Llama 3.2-1B通过前三个步骤,成为正确轨道的四项任务(第3.3节).

blocks.en: Five tasks of the correctness track use Gemma 4 E4B, Llama 3.2 3B, and Qwen3.5-4B: scaffold adaptation on all three targets and construction from interfaces on the first two. We call them the cross-architecture tasks . Each agent makes 24 attempts on each (Table 25 , Figure 10 , Tables 26 – 28 ). On Gemma 4 E4B and Llama 3.2 3B, 116 of 192 scaffold-adaptation attempts are accepted against 56 of 192 from interfaces, and every agent does better from the scaffold on both targets. On Qwen3.5-4B, between 12 of 24 (Opus 5.5) and 21 of 24 (Astra 6 and Fable 5.1) attempts are accepted. blocks.en: Four tasks of the correctness track use Gemma 3 4B (text) and Llama 3.2-1B (Section 2.3 ), each from a scaffold and from interfaces. They require 32 decoding steps and have 1,600 public and 240 held-out cases each. Each agent makes one attempt per task on each of 64 instances of a target, and the eight attempts on one target instance (four agents, two starts) form a matched block: 1,024 attempts in 128 blocks (Figure 11 , Table 32 ). The two starts carry different caps, 16 to 18 hours, 560 to 600 tool calls, and 340k to 360k output tokens from a scaffold against 28 to 30 hours, 860 to 900 calls, and 560k to 600k tokens from interfaces, so a contrast between starts compares complete protocols.
blocks.zh: 正确轨道的四个任务使用Gemma 3 4B(文本)和Llama 3.2-1B(第2.3节),每个任务来自脚手架和接口. 它们需要32个解码步骤,每个有1 600个公开案件和240个搁置案件。 每个代理人对一个目标64个实例中每个实例进行一次尝试,对一个目标实例的8次尝试(4个代理人,2个开始)形成匹配的块:128个街区的1,024次尝试(图11,表32)。 两人开始搭载不同的盖子,16至18小时,560至600个工具呼叫,以及一个脚手架的340k至360k输出信号符对28至30小时,860至900个呼叫符,以及接口的560k至600k信号符,因此起始符之间的对比比较完整协议.

blocks.en: Pooled over agents, 122 of 256 scaffold attempts are accepted on Gemma 3 4B and 170 on Llama 3.2-1B, against 82 and 101 from interfaces, at 29.0 and 18.2 agent-hours per accepted design from a scaffold against 72.5 and 55.9 from interfaces. Every agent has more attempts accepted from the scaffold on both targets. The paired difference is 6.3 to 45.3 points, and six of the eight intervals exclude zero, three after a Holm adjustment. Caps end 326 of the 1,024 attempts: 205 on wall time, 76 on tool calls, and 45 on output tokens. Sol 5.6 has the most accepted attempts on Gemma 3 4B from interfaces and on Llama 3.2-1B from a scaffold and ties Opus 5.5 on Gemma 3 4B from a scaffold; Astra 6 has the most on Llama 3.2-1B from interfaces. Four of the 24 pairwise agent contrasts stay below 0.05 after a Holm adjustment, three of them on Gemma 3 4B from interfaces, where Astra 6 and Fable 5.1 are accepted on 9 and 14 of 64 instances against 28 and 31 for Opus 5.5 and Sol 5.6.
blocks.zh: 256个脚手架尝试中的122个在Gemma 3 4B上接受,170个在Llama 3.2-1B上接受,82个和101个在接口上接受,每个接受的脚手架设计每台29.0个和18.2个代理小时在72.5个和55.9个在接口上接受。 每个特工都有更多的尝试 从脚手架上接受 两个目标。 配位差为6.3至45.3分,8个间隔中的6个排除0,3个经过霍尔姆调整. 1 024次尝试中的326次结束:205次在墙上时间,76次在工具呼叫,45次在输出符. Sol 5.6从接口对Gemma 3 4B的尝试和从脚手架对Llama 3.2-1B的尝试被接受最多,并将Opus 5.5从脚手架对Gemma 3 4B的尝试联系起来; Astra 6从接口对Llama 3.2-1B的尝试最多. 24对映剂中,有4个在Holm调整后保持在0.05以下,其中3个在Gemma 3 4B的界面上,64例中的9例和14例接受Astra 6和Fable 5.1,而Opus 5.5和Sol 5.6则接受28和31例.

blocks.en: The same 128 blocks were first run with eight required decoding steps and suites of 1,320 public and 80 held-out cases, under the same caps (1,024 further attempts, Table 31 ). It falls in 14 of the 16 agent–task cells, most for Sol 5.6 from the Gemma 3 4B scaffold (48 to 35 of 64), and rises for Astra 6 on both Llama 3.2-1B tasks. Caps end 263 attempts at eight steps and 326 at 32, and the mean agent time per attempt rises from 12.8 to 17.8 hours.

blocks.en: D.3 Hardware of accepted correctness-track designs
blocks.zh: D.3 公认的正确性轨道设计的硬件

blocks.en: All 1,016 designs accepted on the twelve tasks of the correctness track, the 246 of the cross-architecture tasks, the 295 full-state designs of the feedback study, and the 475 of the Gemma 3 4B and Llama 3.2-1B tasks, were synthesized, and three accepted designs per agent and task, 144 in all, were placed and routed with three seeds each (Figure 12 , Table 33 ). Each ratio divides by a reference at the same implementation stage and workload. At synthesis, the median LUT ratio per task is 0.97 to 1.10. Construction from interfaces gives both the largest ratios, 1.08 on Gemma 4 E4B and 1.10 on Llama 3.2 3B, and the smallest, 0.97 on Gemma 3 4B and 0.98 on Llama 3.2-1B. Of the 432 route runs, 421 complete, and 134 of the 144 designs complete all three. Among complete designs, the median routed throughput per task is 0.77 to 1.02 times the reference’s, lowest from interfaces on Llama 3.2 3B and Gemma 4 E4B (0.77 and 0.81). Between 11 and 33 of each task’s 36 route runs close timing at 126 MHz, fewest on Qwen3.5-4B. Nano throughput uses one transaction from reset.
blocks.zh: 在正确性轨道的12项任务上接受的所有1,016项设计,跨结构任务的246项设计,反馈研究的295项完整状态设计,以及Gemma 3 4B和Llama 3.2-1B任务的475项设计被合成,每个剂和任务的3项公认设计,共144项,被放置和路由各有3个种子(图12,表33). 在执行阶段和工作量相同时,每个比率都用参考数字来划分。 在合成时,每个任务的LUT中位比为0.97比1.10. 由接口建造,既能给出最大比率,Gemma 4 E4B上的1.08和Llama 3.2 3B上的1.10,又能给出最小比率,Gemma 3 4B上的0.97和Llama 3.2-1B上的0.98. 在432条线路运行中,421条完成,144条设计中有134条完成全部3条. 在完整的设计中,每个任务的路由吞吐量中位数是参考量的0.77至1.02倍,最低值来自Llama 3.2 3B和Gemma 4 E4B上的接口(0.77和0.81)。 每条任务36条线路中11至33条运行时间接近126兆赫,在Quen3.5-4B上最少. 纳诺吞吐量使用重置后的一项交易.

blocks.en: Table 34 : Feedback that locates the first state mismatch raises acceptance over output-only feedback in all 12 agent–task cells. Accepted attempts out of 32 matched blocks per setting, and the full-state minus output-only difference with paired bootstrap 95% intervals; within a block, the three settings share the task instance, starting files, final evaluator, and caps.

blocks.en: In the feedback study, each of the four agents attempts 32 task instances on nano T2, nano T3, and Qwen3.5-0.8B under each of the three feedback settings, and the three attempts on one instance form a matched block (Figure 13 , Tables 34 , 35 , and 36 ). Full-state feedback raises acceptance over output-only feedback in all 12 agent–task cells, by 25.0 to 46.9 points, and every block-bootstrap interval excludes zero. Pooled, 295, 208, and 144 of 384 attempts are accepted under full-state, coarse-state, and output-only feedback. Total agent time is nearly equal across the settings, about 1,930 agent-hours each, so the cost per accepted design falls from 13.4 agent-hours under output-only feedback to 9.3 under coarse-state and 6.5 under full-state feedback. An earlier comparison with Sol 5.6 alone, on 16 instances each of T2 and T3, points the same way: full-state feedback adds two accepted attempts per task (Appendix G ).
blocks.zh: 在反馈研究中,四个代理商在三个反馈设置下各自尝试32个纳米T2,纳米T3和Quen3.5-0.8B任务实例,一个实例的三次尝试形成一个匹配的块(图13,表34,表35,表36)。 全态反馈会提高所有12个代理任务单元格对只输出反馈的接受度,比25.0到46.9分,每个块-bootstrap间隔都排除0. 集合式,295,208,以及384次尝试中的144次在全州,粗体态,只输出反馈下被接受. 在所有设置中,总代理时间几乎相等,每套约1,930个代理小时,所以每个接受的设计成本从只输出反馈下的13.4个代理小时下降到粗态下的9.3个代理小时和全态反馈下的6.5个代理小时. 先前仅与Sol 5.6比较,T2和T3的16个实例都指向了同样的方式:全状态反馈每个任务都增加了两个被接受的尝试(Appendix G.

blocks.en: Full-state feedback exceeds coarse-state feedback in all 12 cells, by 9.4 to 37.5 points, and these intervals exclude zero in seven of 12 cells; the intervals for coarse-state against output-only feedback exclude zero in two. Intervals are percentile block bootstraps (2,000 resamples of whole blocks, fixed seed), computed from the paired attempt records. Across 100 bootstrap seeds, the full-minus-output intervals exclude zero in all 12 cells under every seed. The full-minus-coarse intervals exclude zero in six to eight cells and the coarse-minus-output intervals in two to four, because several of their bounds lie at zero.
blocks.zh: 全态反馈在所有12个细胞中均超过粗态反馈,比9.4至37.5点,这些间隔排除了12个细胞中的7个中的0;粗态相对于只输出反馈的间隔排除了2个中的0. 间距是百分位区块的靴子(2 000个整块的复标,固定种子),从成对的尝试记录计算。 在100个靴子种子中,完全减产间隔在每个种子下的所有12个细胞中排除0。 完全小于粗的间隔排除在6至8个细胞中的0,粗小于输出间隔排除在2至4,因为其数个边距处于0.

blocks.en: Output-only feedback reports no state values, so whether an agent has found a state defect can be observed only under the other two settings. Among attempts with a state defect, agents found it within budget in 142 of 169 coarse-state attempts and 151 of 166 full-state attempts, and repaired it in 87 and 123 (Table 37 ). Measured from the start of the attempt, the median discovery took 1.50 agent-hours and 58 tool calls under coarse-state feedback and 1.35 hours and 57 calls under full-state feedback. The median completed repair took 3.22 hours (118 calls, 51.4k output tokens) and 2.69 hours (117 calls, 52.6k tokens).
blocks.zh: 只输出反馈报告没有状态值,所以一个代理机是否发现状态缺陷只能在其他两种设置下观察到. 在有国家缺陷的尝试中,特工在预算范围内发现了169次粗体国家尝试中的142次和166次全州尝试中的151次,并在87次和123次中进行了修复(表37)。 从尝试开始时算起,中位发现在粗态反馈下需要1.50个代理小时和58个工具呼叫,在全态反馈下需要1.35小时和57个呼叫. 完成的中位修复共耗时3.22小时(118个电话,51.4k输出令牌)和2.69小时(117个电话,52.6k令牌).

blocks.en: Table 38 adds intervals to the pooled costs. Each bootstrap draw resamples whole matched blocks, which keeps the four agents and three settings of an instance together; failed and capped attempts count toward agent time, and grading time does not. Pooled over agents and tasks, output-only feedback costs 13.38 [11.25, 16.19] agent-hours per accepted design, coarse-state 9.33 [8.16, 10.77], and full-state 6.55 [5.92, 7.31]; as ratios to output-only, 0.70 [0.60, 0.81] and 0.49 [0.42, 0.56]. Per agent and task (Table 39 ), every full-state ratio has an interval below one, from 0.29 [0.12, 0.50] for Sol 5.6 on T3 to 0.65 [0.44, 0.90] for Opus 5.5 on T2, while eight of the 12 coarse-state intervals include one. To check whether a few attempts drive the ratios, we removed one matched block at a time. Over all 96 deletions the pooled full-state ratio stays between 0.48 and 0.50, and no deletion raises an agent–task full-state ratio above 0.71 (Figure 14 ). Removing single attempts, over all 1,152 deletions, keeps the pooled ratio between 0.486 and 0.492.

blocks.zh: D.5 控制范围、附加状态和预算

blocks.en: Nano tasks T1 to T3 differ in several properties at once. The controlled matrix instead starts every attempt from one Qwen3.5-nano scaffold, grades it with the same evaluator, and varies three factors: the number of decoding steps that must match (1, 4, 8, or 16), an added state condition (none, reset after activity, or bounded memory stalls), and a budget multiplier that scales all three caps (0.5, 1, or 1.5). The public and held-out suites grow with the horizon, from 984 and 68 cases at one step to 1,344 and 128 at 16. Each agent has 24 blocks per cell (Figure 15 , Tables 40 – 41 ).

blocks.en: Table 42 and Figure 16 ask whether an added state condition changes how acceptance falls with the horizon. For each budget, the horizon effect is acceptance at 16 steps minus acceptance at one step, and the interaction is the horizon effect with an added condition minus the effect without one. At 0.5 × \times , both interactions are positive, 15.6 points [5.2, 26.0] for reset after activity and 27.1 [18.8, 35.4] for stalls: at 16 steps, at most 1 of 96 attempts per condition is accepted, so conditions that start lower at one step have less room to fall. blocks.en: D.6 Long-horizon regrading
blocks.zh: D.6 长视距调整

blocks.en: Section 4.3 reports the regrading of 144 frozen submissions on Qwen3.5-0.8B, Gemma 4 E4B, and Llama 3.2 3B, 12 per agent and target, together with the three reference designs. Figure 17 and Tables 43 and 44 give the results at every horizon. Regrading involves no new attempts and changes no acceptance decision. The 69 accepted submissions are all exact at eight steps. At 32 steps, the horizon their tasks required, 85 of their 2,208 sequences fail, in 45 submissions. On new prefixes alone, 454 of their 552 sequences are still exact at 256 steps. Stalls remain the hardest condition at 256 steps, with 60.6 to 69.9% of sequences exact per target against 75.6 to 86.1% on new prefixes alone (Table 44 ). Of the 624 sequences that fail at 256 steps, 482 first diverge in persistent state and 142 in output arithmetic. In 470 of the 482, the output also mismatches within 256 steps, a median of four decode positions after the first state mismatch (interquartile range two to eight, at most 40); in the other 12, no output mismatch appears within 256 steps. Counted by design instead of by sequence, 24 of the 69 accepted submissions are exact on all 32 sequences at 32 steps, seven at 64 steps, and none at 128 steps.
blocks.zh: 第4.3节报告,对Quen3.5-0.8B、Gemma 4 E4B和Llama 3.2 3B的144份被冻结的呈文以及三个参考设计进行了重新编号。 图17和表43和表44列出了每一方面的结果。 降级不涉及新的尝试,也不改变接受决定。 69份被接受的呈文完全分8个步骤。 在32个步骤中,他们的任务范围需要,其中85个序列失败,有45个提交。 仅在新的前缀上,其552个序列中的454个仍然精确在256步. 在256个步骤中,Stalls仍然是最困难的条件,每个目标序列的精确度为60.6%至69.9%,而仅在新的前缀上,序列的精确度为75.6%至86.1%(表44)。 在256步失败的624个序列中,482个序列在持续状态下首次出现差异,142个序列在产出算术上出现差异. 在482年的470个中,输出也在256步内出现不匹配,在第一次状态不匹配后,中间位数为4个解码位置(中间位数在2到8之间,最多40个);在其他12个中,在256步内没有出现输出不匹配. 按设计而不是顺序计算,69份被接受的呈文中,有24份精确于32步的所有32个序列,7份精确于64步,没有一份精确于128步.

blocks.en: Table 45 separates the failing sequences by what is wrong. At the 32 steps the tasks required, 85 sequences of the accepted submissions fail: 51 in both stored state and output, 17 in state only, and 17 in output only. A test of that length that compared outputs alone would pass the 17 state-only sequences, nine of which are under bounded memory stalls and five under reset after activity. Longer runs do not add such sequences: at 256 steps, 12 of the 624 failing sequences are wrong in state only. Counted by design (Table 46 ), 45 accepted designs fail within 32 steps and 5 of them fail only in state; from 128 steps on, all 69 fail in output. Of the 482 sequences that first diverge in state, 470 show a wrong output a median of four steps later (quartiles 2 and 8, maximum 40), and 12 show none within 256 steps (Figure 18 ).
blocks.zh: 表45将失败的序列按错误区分开。 在所需任务的32个步骤中,85个已接受的提交序列失败:51个既存储状态又输出状态,17个仅存储状态,17个仅输出状态. 仅对输出进行比较的长度测试,即可通过17个仅限状态的序列,其中9个处于有限度的内存档下,5个在活动后重新设置。 较长的运行不会添加这样的序列:在256步,624个失败序列中的12个只在状态上是错误的. 按设计计算(表46),在32步内有45个被接受的设计失败,其中5步只在状态下失败;从128步开始,全部69步在输出上都失败. 在首次在状态中出现差异的482个序列中,470个显示的输出偏差是4个步骤的中位数(第2位数和第8位数,最高40位数),12个显示在256个步骤内无一个(图18 ).

blocks.en: Table 47 compares the 32-step full-state check with output-only checks of 32 to 64 steps on the same 2,208 sequences. The full-state check detects 85 sequences in 45 designs, and the 32-step output check 68 in 40. At 35 steps the output check detects 79 sequences; it still misses 10 that the full-state check finds and finds 4 that it misses, a difference of 0.27 points [ − 0.05 -0.05 , 0.63]. From 38 steps on, the output check detects more sequences than the 32-step full-state check, and at 48 steps it detects all 85, among 117 in 53 designs. On these designs, a full-state check finds the defects at a shorter horizon, and an output check that runs 50% longer finds the same ones.
blocks.zh: 表47将32步全状态检查与同2,208个序列上32至64步只输出检查进行比较. 全状态检查在45个设计中检测到85个序列,32步输出检查在40个中检测到68个序列. 在35个步骤中,输出检查检测到79个序列;它仍然漏掉10个全状态检查发现并发现4个缺失,差值为0.27分[−0.05-0.05,0.63]. 从38步开始,输出检查比32步全状态检查更能检测到序列,在48步,它检测到全部85步,在53个设计中的117步中. 在这些设计上,一个全状态检查在较短的视野中发现缺陷,一个运行了50%更长的输出检查发现同样的缺陷.
