blocks.en: D.7 Submission timing and failure outcomes
blocks.zh: D.7 提交时间和失败结果

blocks.en: Figure 19 and Table 48 classify every attempt in the feedback study, on Gemma 4 E4B and Llama 3.2 3B, and in the controlled matrix at the 1 × \times budget by how it ended: accepted, submitted and rejected (with the grader’s primary diagnosis), or stopped at the wall-time, tool-call, or output-token cap. From output-only to full-state feedback, state/protocol rejections fall from 81 to 17 of 384 attempts and cap exits from 58 to 43. Under full-state feedback, caps end 43 of the 89 failed attempts: 26 had no state defect, 13 had already repaired one, and four reached the cap before the repair was complete. Caps also end 70 of the 136 failed attempts at construction from interfaces and 86 of the 173 failed 16-step attempts in the controlled matrix. Figure 6 gives excerpts from three attempt records.
blocks.zh: 图19和表48将反馈研究中关于Gemma 4 E4B和Llama 3.2 3B的每一项尝试,以及在1××时预算的控制矩阵中,按其结束方式分类:接受、提交和拒绝(与年级生的初级诊断),或停止在墙上时间、工具呼叫或输出托肯盖。 从只输出到全状态反馈,州/州拒绝数从384次尝试中的81次降至17次,上限退出数从58次降至43次. 在全州反馈下,89次失败尝试中的43次封顶结束:26次没有州缺陷,13次已经修复1次,4次在修复完成前到达封顶. Caps还结束了136次从界面建造失败的尝试中的70次,以及控制矩阵中173次16步失败的尝试中的86次. 图6摘录了三项尝试记录。

blocks.en: Under every feedback setting, accepted designs were submitted at a median of 56 to 59% of the wall cap, but the settings separate early. By half the cap, 52, 67, and 82 of 384 attempts under output-only, coarse-state, and full-state feedback had submitted a design that was later accepted, and by three quarters of the cap, 122, 164, and 232 had. Only 6, 10, and 20 accepted designs were submitted after 90% of the cap. On Gemma 4 E4B and Llama 3.2 3B, accepted designs arrived at medians of 67% (scaffold adaptation) and 66% (construction from interfaces) of the cap, and 85 and 36 of 192 attempts had submitted one by three quarters of it. The controlled matrix varies the caps directly (Appendix D.5 ).
blocks.zh: 在每一个反馈设置下,接受的设计都是以壁盖的56%至59%的中位数提交,但设置提前分开. 在只输出,粗态,全态反馈的384次尝试中,有一半,52次,67次,82次提交了后来被接受的设计,在上限的四分之三,122次,164次,232次都有. 只有6,10,20个被接受的设计在90%的封顶后提交. 在Gemma 4 E4B和Llama 3.2 3B上,接受的设计达到了67%(手腕改造)和66%(从接口建造)的上限,192次尝试中有85次和36次提交了其中四分之一的尝试. 控制矩阵直接改变盖(附录D.5 ).

blocks.en: Table 50 follows each submission in the feedback study from the checks the agent could see to final acceptance. Under coarse-state and full-state feedback, every submission that passes the visible checks also passes the full public suite (252 and 314), and 208 and 295 are accepted.

blocks.en: Three experiments rank the agents, and their rankings reproduce across random halves of the instances (Table 56 ). On the correctness track, Sol 5.6 has 289 of 472 attempts accepted, Opus 5.5 264, Astra 6 235, and Fable 5.1 228 ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ); the Kendall τ \tau between the orders of two random halves averages 0.78 ( p = 0.001 p=0.001 ), and the halves give the same order of all four agents in 64 of 200 splits. On the controlled matrix, Fable 5.1 has 445 of 864 attempts accepted, Astra 6 422, Opus 5.5 405, and Sol 5.6 385 ( p = 0.001 p=0.001 ); the split-half τ \tau is 0.80 ( p = 0.001 p=0.001 ), and the halves give the same order in 102 of 200 splits. On the PPA track, Fable 5.1 improves 184 of 384 designs and Sol 5.6 151, against 123 and 111 for Astra 6 and Opus 5.5 ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ); the split-half τ \tau is 0.87 ( p = 0.001 p=0.001 ), and the halves give the same order in 116 of 200 splits. Each ranking describes its own experiment: Sol 5.6 is first on the correctness track, second on the PPA track, and last on the controlled matrix. The overall score of Appendix D.9 combines the two tracks of the benchmark and leaves the diagnostic studies out.

blocks.en: On the controlled matrix, Sol 5.6 falls behind through designs it submits and the grader rejects. At 16 steps, each agent ends 93 to 96 of its 216 attempts at a cap. Sol 5.6 has 63 of its 121 submitted designs rejected, against 54 of 121 for Opus 5.5, 48 of 120 for Astra 6, and 35 of 123 for Fable 5.1. Of Sol 5.6’s 63, 50 were submitted while failing public tests the agent had seen (24 of 35 for Fable 5.1), and the grader’s primary diagnosis is arithmetic for 28, integration for 22, and state or protocol for 13. Its rejected submissions grow from 24 at one step to 63 at 16, against 18 and 35 for Fable 5.1, and at 16 steps it has 21 and 37 attempts accepted at the 1 × \times and 1.5 × \times budgets, against 37 and 50 for Fable 5.1. On the six scaffold-adaptation tasks of the correctness track, Sol 5.6 submits 196 of 232 attempts, more than any other agent, and 18 of those submissions fail the public tests it had seen, the fewest of the four.

Sol 5.6在提交的121项设计中有63项被拒绝,而Opus 5.5为121项中的54项,Astra 6为120项中的48项,Fable 5.1为123项中的35项。 在Sol 5.6的63例中,50例是在未进行公开测试的情况下提交的,而该药剂(Fable 5.1的35例中有24例)的初级诊断是28例的算术,22例的结合,13例的状态或规程。 它被否决的呈文从24份一步增加到63份16份,而Fable 5.1的呈文是18份和35份,在16个步骤中,它接受了21份和37份在1xxx时间和1.5xxx时间的预算,而Fable 5.1的呈文是37份和50份。 在正确性轨道的六个脚手架适应任务上,Sol 5.6提交了232次尝试中的196次,比任何其他尝试都多,其中18次未能通过它所看到的公开测试,是4次测试中最少的一次。

blocks.en: On the correctness track, three pairwise differences are distinguishable from zero after a Holm adjustment over the six pairs (Table 52 ): Sol 5.6 over Astra 6, 11.4 points with a 95% interval of 6.4 to 16.5; Sol 5.6 over Fable 5.1, 12.9 points (8.1 to 18.0); and Opus 5.5 over Fable 5.1, 7.6 points (2.5 to 12.7). All four agents are accepted on 99 of the 472 instances and none on 74; on the other 299, the agents disagree. Any two agents disagree on about 35% of the instances, so at this size the track detects a paired difference of about 8 points with 80% power. Among the twelve tasks, three separate the agents after a Holm adjustment: Gemma 3 4B from interfaces ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), where Astra 6 and Fable 5.1 are accepted on 9 and 14 of 64 instances against 28 and 31 for Opus 5.5 and Sol 5.6; scaffold adaptation of Llama 3.2-1B ( p = 0.007 p=0.007 ), where Sol 5.6 is accepted on 54 of 64 instances and the others on 35 to 41; and scaffold adaptation of Qwen3.5-4B ( p = 0.015 p=0.015 ), where Opus 5.5 is accepted on 12 of 24 instances and the others on 20 or 21.

blocks.en: The overall score of Section 2.4 multiplies a correctness-track score by a PPA-track score. The correctness score is the acceptance rate on each of the twelve correctness-track tasks, averaged over the tasks, so the tasks with 64 instances weigh no more than those with 24. The PPA score is the rate of improved designs on each of Qwen3.5-0.8B and 4B, Gemma 4 E4B, and Llama 3.2 3B, averaged over the four. Table 53 gives the score, its two factors, and the other rates of both tracks. Intervals are paired percentile bootstraps: each resample draws instances with replacement within each task and keeps the four agents’ outcomes on an instance together.
blocks.zh: 第2.4节的总分乘以PPA轨分的正确性分数. 正确性分数是十二个正确性轨迹任务中的每一个任务的接受率,平均于任务,因此64个例的任务重量不超过24个. PPA分数是Quen3.5-0.8B和4B,Gemma 4 E4B,以及Llama 3.2 3B的每款改进设计率,平均比四款高. 表53给出了分数,它的两个因素,以及两轨的其他率. 间隙是成对的百分位靴子:每个复刻都以替换方式绘制实例,并将四个代理的结果放在一个实例上。

blocks.en: Fable 5.1 and Sol 5.6 score 25.0 and 24.5, and Astra 6 and Opus 5.5 score 16.8 and 16.5. The four differences between an agent of the first pair and one of the second are 7.7 to 8.5 points (Table 54 ). The bootstrap intervals of all four exclude zero, and a paired permutation test gives a Holm-adjusted p p of 0.002 for each. Within each pair the difference is 0.5 and 0.3 points, and Fable 5.1 has the highest score in 58% of the resamples against 42% for Sol 5.6. We also test whether the ranking reproduces (Table 56 ). Each split divides the matched instances of every correctness task and PPA target into two random halves and computes the score on each half. Both halves rank Sol 5.6 and Fable 5.1 above Astra 6 and Opus 5.5 in all 200 splits, against 17% of splits when the four agents’ outcomes are permuted within instances ( p = 0.001 p=0.001 ).
blocks.zh: 寓言5.1和索尔5.6的得分为25.0和24.5,Astra 6和Opus 5.5的得分为16.8和16.5. 第一对的代理人和第二对的代理人之间的四个区别是7.7至8.5分(表54. 所有四个的靴子间隔都不包括0,一个对接的穿透试验给出的Holm调整p每张0.002. 每对中的差异为0.5分和0.3分,Fable 5.1在58%的复标中得分最高,而Sol 5.6的得分最高. 我们还测试排名是否复制(表56)。 每个拆分将每个正确性任务的对应实例和PPA目标分为两个随机的二分之一,并计算每分之一的得分. 在所有200个拆分中,两半都将Sol 5.6和Fable 5.1排在Astra 6和Opus 5.5上,而当四个代理商的结果在个案中渗透时则占拆分的17%(p=0.001 p=0.001)。

blocks.en: Which of the first two agents leads depends on how the tracks are combined (Table 55 ). Sol 5.6 has the higher correctness score and Fable 5.1 the higher PPA score. Fable 5.1 is first under the product, and Sol 5.6 under the mean of the two track scores and when the sixteen tasks weigh equally, which gives the PPA track one quarter of the weight. Under every definition that includes the PPA track, both score above Astra 6 and Opus 5.5. We multiply the track scores because the benchmark asks for a design that is both correct and efficient: the product is high only when both rates are, and it is the probability that one attempt at a randomly drawn correctness task and one at a randomly drawn PPA target both succeed, if the two are independent.
blocks.zh: 前两个代理中哪一个领先取决于轨迹的组合方式(表55). Sol 5.6的正确度分数较高,Fable 5.1的PPA分数较高. 寓言5.1在产品下位居第一,Sol 5.6在两个音轨分数的平均值下位居第一,16项任务均重时位居第一,这使得PPA音轨占重量的四分之一. 在包括PPA赛道的每一个定义下,均得分均高于Astra 6和Opus 5.5. 我们乘以音轨分数,因为基准要求设计既正确又有效率:产品只有在两种速率都达到时才会很高,而且如果两者是独立的,那么一次随机抽取正确性任务的尝试和一次随机抽取的PPA目标都有可能成功.

blocks.en: Both optimized schedules raise throughput by 12.0% and add about 300 LUTs (under 1%) in the pre-route estimate. After place and route (Appendix E.2 ), the optimized designs use 61.5k (0.8B) and 69.2k (4B) LUTs, against the estimated 62.1k and 69.3k. Both designs time-multiplex a shared compute engine and stream weights from external storage, so the larger model adds computation and memory traffic without a proportionally larger datapath. Within each workload, the two schedules use the same arithmetic and therefore have the same fidelity.
blocks.zh: 两种优化的时间表都提高了12.0%的吞吐量,并在预序估计中增加了约300个LUT(低于1%). 在位置和路线(附录E.2 )之后,优化后的设计使用61.5k(0.8B)和69.2k(4B)LUT,而估计使用62.1k和69.3k. 两者都从外部存储中设计出一个共享的计算引擎和流重,因此更大的模型增加了计算和内存流量,没有按比例较大的数据路径. 在每个工作量中,两个时间表使用相同的算术,因此具有相同的忠诚。

blocks.en: The optimized schedules raise FPGA-plus-DRAM power by about 3.9%, so the 12.0% throughput gain gives an estimated efficiency gain of 7.8%. Energy per token falls from 2.2456 to 2.0831 J (Qwen3.5-0.8B) and from 12.6125 to 11.6964 J (Qwen3.5-4B).
blocks.zh: 优化的时间表将FPGA-plus-DRAM的功率提升了约3.9%,因此12.0%的吞吐量增益估计能提高效率增益7.8%. 每令牌的能量从2.2456升至2.0831升(Quen3.5-0.8B),从12.6125升至11.6964升(Quen3.5-4B).

blocks.en: We report power at three levels: estimates, post-route reports, and board measurements. Estimates come from a power budget, which links power and work counts to energy, or from a post-synthesis power report, which assumes a clock, voltage, temperature, process, and switching activity. Post-route reports add physical implementation information, and board measurements observe the running design (Appendix E.2 ). Vendor guidance [ AMD, 2026a ] emphasizes both switching annotation and implementation information.
blocks.zh: 我们在三个层次上报告功率:估计数、后周期报告和板面测量。 估计数来自将功率和工作数与能源联系起来的动力预算,或来自合成后功率报告,其中假设时钟、电压、温度、过程和切换活动。 程序后报告增加了实际执行信息,板面测量观测运行设计(附录E.2.). 供应商指南[AMD, 2026a]强调转换注释和执行信息。

blocks.en: Let g R = R 1 / R 0 g_{R}=R_{1}/R_{0} and g P = P 1 / P 0 g_{P}=P_{1}/P_{0} . The energy-efficiency gain is g R / g P − 1 g_{R}/g_{P}-1 , so it vanishes when power rises as much as throughput: the 10.5% throughput gain for Qwen3.5-nano gives no energy benefit if power also rises by 10.5%, and the 12.0% gains for 0.8B and 4B break even at a 12.0% power increase.
E.2 Physical implementation and board power
blocks.zh: E.2 实际执行和董事会权力

blocks.en: The baseline and optimized schedules of the 0.8B and 4B reference designs were each placed and routed with three implementation seeds and measured on the board with five repeats per seed (Figure 21 , Tables 60 and 61 ). Every baseline implementation and every optimized 4B implementation meets 126 MHz. The optimized 0.8B design meets it on one of three seeds; the other two close at a lower clock, so its mean operating clock is 125.3 MHz and its throughput gain is 11.4–11.8%. Mean post-route LUT counts change by − 0.2 -0.2 % for both workloads, where the estimates of Table 57 showed an increase of about 300 LUTs, and BRAM rises by 2.2% and 1.6%.
blocks.zh: 0.8B和4B参考设计的基准和优化时间表分别用三个执行种子放置和路由,并在棋盘上进行测量,每个种子重复5次(图21,表60和61)。 每个基线实施和每个优化的4B实施都满足126MHz. 优化后的0.8B设计在三个种子中的一个上满足它;另外两个在一个下钟关闭,因此其平均操作时钟为125.3MHz,其吞吐量增益为11.4–11.8%. 路线后LUT的平均变动幅度为−0.2-0.2%,其中表57的估计数显示大约增加了300个LUT,而BRAM则增加了2.2%和1.6%。

blocks.en: Measured board power rises by 3.1% (0.8B) and 3.7% (4B), and energy per token falls by 7.8% and 7.1%. The resulting efficiency gains, 8.5% and 7.7%, lie within a percentage point of the estimated 7.8%. Paired by seed and repeat, all 15 board pairs of each workload show an efficiency gain, from 3.5% to 13.6% for 0.8B and from 4.7% to 12.4% for 4B, with seed means of 7.5–9.3% and 6.9–8.2%. All implementations target the AMD Alveo U250 device xcu250-figd2104-2L-e and were built with Vivado 2024.1, the version recorded in the Vivado logs, timing reports, and bitstream headers. Board power is read from the U250’s on-board sensors through XRT 2.16.204 and sums the core (0.85 V), auxiliary (1.8 V), and DRAM (1.2 V) rails, sampled at 1 kHz. Each seed is measured in five non-overlapping 10 s windows. The reported board power is the total of the three rails during these windows, the same quantity as the post-route estimates it is compared with; each rail’s median idle power over the 30 s before the workload is recorded and is not subtracted. The memory-service model is cycle-relative: a request waits 48 cycles, each 64-byte beat then takes one cycle, bursts have 8 to 16 beats, and the interface delivers at most one beat per cycle at 126 MHz; under the bounded-memory-stall condition of the regrading and the controlled matrix, response delays are drawn uniformly from 0 to 256 cycles. The held-out backpressure test and the local checks use shorter stalls of one to three cycles (Appendix B.1 ).

blocks.en: Every physical result in this paper comes from the FPGA flow described above. Vivado implementation places a synthesized netlist onto the U250’s existing resources (look-up tables, flip-flops, block RAM, DSP slices, and programmable interconnect), routes it, checks timing, and writes a bitstream [ AMD, 2026b ] . The quantities it yields are resource counts, the clock the routed design achieves, and, on the board, rail power. OpenROAD [ Ajayi et al., 2019 ] and the flows built on it target ASIC design: starting from RTL and a process design kit, they synthesize to a standard-cell library and carry the design through floorplanning, macro and standard-cell placement, clock-tree synthesis, global and detailed routing, and layout generation in GDSII. Their outputs are a cell area, routed timing, congestion, and power for a chip that would be fabricated, with design-rule checks before signoff. The two flows therefore answer different questions about the same RTL. The contract, the oracle, and the simulation-based tests are independent of the implementation flow; the PPA criterion of Equation 3 is stated in FPGA LUTs at a 126 MHz clock. Extending the PPA track to ASICs would require choosing a PDK and standard-cell library, generating or selecting memory macros for the caches and weight buffers, writing timing constraints for that process, adding physical verification, and restating the area term in cell area. Such results would not be comparable with the LUT counts and board power reported here.

OpenROAD [Ajayi et al., 2019] 及其上建的流量目标ASIC设计:从RTL和一个流程设计包开始,它们合成到一个标准细胞库,并通过地板规划,宏和标准细胞布置,钟树合成,全球和详细路由,以及GDSII的布局生成来进行设计. 他们的输出是一个细胞区,路由计时,拥堵,以及用于制造芯片的动力,在签字前进行设计规则检查. 因此,这两种流动回答了关于同一RTL的不同问题。 合同,甲骨文,和模拟测试独立于执行流程;方程式3的PPA标准在FPGA LUTs中以126MHz时钟表示. 将 PPA 轨迹扩展至 ASICs 需要选择 PDK 和标准单元格库, 生成或选择缓存和重量缓冲器的内存宏, 写入此过程的计时限制, 添加物理校验, 并在单元格区域重写区域名 。 这些结果与本文所报告的LUT计数和板机功率无法相比。

blocks.en: A cycle model shows where the optimized schedule saves time. For both workloads, compute, memory waits, and control take 65, 28, and 7% of the cycles per token under the baseline schedule and 73, 22, and 5% under the optimized one. Doubling memory bandwidth raises the Qwen3.5-0.8B baseline throughput by 14%, from 3.999 to 4.563 tokens/s. In the cycle and power model for Qwen3.5-4B, enabling buffering, overlap, and the revised schedule together lowers cycles per token by 10.7%, and overlap gives the largest single reduction. In sweeps that vary bandwidth, latency, prompt length, or resource budget one at a time around the nominal operating point, the optimized schedule keeps its advantage, and its relative gain is largest when memory latency is high or bandwidth is low.

blocks.en: On common prefixes, the Gemma 2 2B contract matches FP32 on 1,574 of 1,600 top-1 decisions and the Gemma 3 4B contract on 1,584 (Table 67 gives the percentages by position). Gemma 2 2B therefore misses the 99% fidelity threshold although its RTL matches its integer oracle on every case. Building these reference designs involved no agent attempts.

blocks.en: The Qwen3.6-27B configuration [ Qwen Team, 2026b ] is a dense hybrid decoder with 64 layers, hidden width 5,120, and a full-attention layer every fourth layer. Like the Qwen3.5 configurations [ Qwen Team, 2026a , Qwen Team, 2026c ] , it has a gated attention output, but reusing the Qwen3.5 scaffold still required checking gate arithmetic, state layouts, and address ranges. Its public suite has 1,000 operator cases, 128 GDN-layer cases, 128 full-attention-layer cases, 32 one-step cases, 16 eight-step cases, and 16 reset cases. All operator and layer cases pass, but four one-step and four eight-step cases fail. Table 66 gives its ten held-out failures by condition.
blocks.zh: Quen3.6-27号 B配置 [Quen Team, 2026b]是一个密密的混合解码器,有64层,隐藏宽度5,120,每第四层有一个全注层. 和Quen3.5配置 [Quen Team, 2026a, Quen Team, 2026c] 一样,它具有有门的注意输出,但重新使用Quen3.5脚手架仍然需要检查闸门算术,状态布局,地址范围. 其公共套房有1 000个操作员案例,128个GDN级案例,128个全注级案例,32个单步案例,16个八步案例,16个重置案例. 所有操作员和层层案例都通过,但4个1步和4个8步案例失败. 表66按条件列出其10次被搁置的失败。

blocks.en: Llama 3.2-1B [ Meta, 2024 ] is a compact text-only decoder from a third family. Its suites have the same allocation as the Gemma 3 4B suites, under its own attention, normalization, and positional contract, and all 1,600 public and 240 held-out cases of its 32-step suite pass.
blocks.zh: Llama 3.2-1B [Meta, 2024])是来自第三家族的紧凑文本唯一的解码器. 其套房与Gemma 3 4B套房的配置相同,在自己的关注,正常化和职位合同下,其32步套房通行证的所有1 600个公共和240个被搁置的案例.

Qwen3.6-27B’s RTL matches its integer oracle on 1,312 of 1,320 public and 70 of 80 held-out cases, Gemma 2 2B’s on all 1,400 cases of its suites, and Gemma 3 4B’s and Llama 3.2-1B’s on all 1,840 of theirs (Table 4 ).

blocks.en: Qwen3.6-27B and Gemma 2 2B do not qualify, for different reasons (Section 3.3 ). We revised the Qwen3.6-27B RTL twice and evaluated eight alternative integer contracts for Gemma 2 2B.
blocks.zh: Qune3.6-27B和Gemma 2 2B不符合条件,原因不同(第3.3节)。 我们两次修订了Qwen3.6-27BRTL,并评价了Gemma 2 2B的8个替代整数合同。

blocks.en: The two revisions of the Qwen3.6-27B reference reduce its failures from eighteen cases, all at the integration levels (Appendix F.1.1 ), to one or two (Figure 24 a, Table 68 ). Revision A passes all 80 held-out cases but misses one eight-step public case and one regression case under stalls. Revision B passes every public and regression case but misses one held-out parameter-reload case. Neither revision passes every check, so Qwen3.6-27B does not qualify.
blocks.zh: Quen3.6-27B参考文献的两处修订案将其失败率从18例(均为整合级别(附录F.1.1))降至1或2例(图24a,表68)。 订正 80个被搁置的案件都通过许可,但错过了一个八步公开的案件和一个倒退案件。 订正 B通过每一个公开和回归案件,但错过了一个被搁置参数重载的案件。 两次修改都没有通过每次检查,因此Quen3.6-27B没有资格.

blocks.en: Gemma 2 2B’s fidelity shortfall is a property of its contract: seven of eight alternative integer contracts reach the 99% fidelity threshold, from 99.12% with 8-bit calibrated per-channel scaling to 99.90% at 16 bits (Table 69 ). All four additional reference designs meet timing, and Gemma 3 4B and Llama 3.2-1B pass every gate (Table 70 ).

blocks.en: Before the runs of the correctness track, the four agents ran an earlier series of four tasks under full-state feedback: Qwen3.5-nano T1 (one decoder layer), T2 (the four-layer decoder for one step), and T3 (eight recurrent steps), each built from interfaces with 16 attempts per agent, and scaffold adaptation of Qwen3.5-0.8B with 12 attempts per agent (Table 71 ). The nano tasks follow the order in which a decoder accelerator is assembled, so each task requires more integration than the one before. Wall-time caps and test suites also grow from T1 to T3, so a difference between T1 and T3 combines integration, horizon, budget, and suite size. Sol 5.6 and Astra 6 ran these tasks first, on shared task instances, for 96 nano attempts and 24 adaptation attempts. A feedback pilot added 32 output-only Sol 5.6 attempts on T2 and T3, which gives the 152 attempts of this cohort. Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 ran the four tasks later with the same harness, caps, test counts, and feedback. Because the two cohorts ran at different times, we compare agents only within a cohort.

Sol 5.6和Astra 6首先执行这些任务,涉及共同的任务实例,涉及96纳米尝试和24次适应尝试。 一个反馈试验增加了32个只输出的Sol 5.6对T2和T3的尝试,这使得这组人的152次尝试. Opus 5.5和Fable 5.1在后来用相同的绳子,盖子,测试计数和反馈来运行这四个任务. 因为两组人跑在不同的时间, 我们只比较一组人的特工。
